Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

Alteryx is searching for a Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security. This position is remote-friendly.

Position Overview:

The successful candidate will serve as a primary legal advisor on privacy, data protection, information security, and AI matters, with a principal focus on leading complex customer and vendor negotiations involving these specialized requirements. Candidates for this position will be qualified lawyers with strong transactional experience and in-house experience within the technology sector, preferably in software and multiplatform environments (on-premises, native SaaS, and hybrid solutions). Candidates should be skilled and enthusiastic users and learners of AI tools as part of their day-to-day legal responsibilities. The ideal candidate will thrive as an independent self-starter with significant autonomy in a fast-paced, business- and results-oriented environment.

Primary Responsibilities:

Customer Contract Negotiations

  • Lead negotiations and escalations involving privacy, data protection, information security, AI, HIPAA, and other specialized legal and regulatory requirements.

  • Develop practical positions that address legal risk while supporting customer relationships and timely deal closure.

  • Communicate complex legal and regulatory concepts clearly to internal audiences, and effectively convey Alteryx’s position to customers, their counsel, and their privacy and security teams.

  • Anticipate objections and recurring points of friction, and resolve them independently or in collaboration with peers and senior staff.

Vendor Contract Negotiations

  • Review and negotiate vendor terms involving privacy, security, AI, HIPAA, data use, and other specialized requirements.

  • Coordinate with Procurement, Information Security, business owners, and other Legal teams to assess risk, establish appropriate safeguards, and resolve escalated issues.

Contract Templates and Legal Standards

  • Create and maintain standardized agreements, addenda, and supporting materials, including the Customer DPA, Vendor DPA, Customer Information Security Program Description, Vendor Security Standards, HIPAA Business Associate Agreement, customer AI terms, and vendor AI terms.

  • Update templates to address regulatory developments, negotiation experience, and changes in Alteryx products and operations.

Public-Facing Privacy and Trust Documentation

  • Develop and maintain customer-facing privacy, data-use, security, and compliance materials.

Policies, Playbooks, and Legal Enablement

  • Develop and maintain internal policies, negotiation playbooks, and practical guidance. Translate legal requirements and approved risk positions into repeatable processes that enable consistent decision-making across Legal and the business.

Your Background:

  • A qualified attorney admitted to practice in one or more states in the United States and a member of one or more state Bar(s) in good standing, with a license to practice law within the state employed;

  • Seven-plus years of experience as in-house counsel (law firm experience helpful but not required);

  • Substantial experience negotiating privacy, data protection, and information security terms in enterprise software transactions, on both the customer and vendor side;

  • Deep working knowledge of global privacy and data protection law (including GDPR, U.S. state privacy laws, and international transfer mechanisms), information security requirements and frameworks, HIPAA and emerging AI regulation;

  • Successful completion of one or more IAPP certifications (CIPP, CIPM, AIGP) preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience drafting and maintaining contract templates, playbooks, policies, and public-facing privacy documentation;

  • Demonstrated knowledge of best-practice internal controls, procedures, risk surveillance, and escalation;

  • Excellent oral and written, presentation and interpersonal communication skills;

  • Excellent negotiation skills;

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex legal issues and solutions to clients clearly and succinctly, and to develop credibility at all levels of the business organization;

  • Proven analytical, time management, and problem-solving skills.

Personal Qualifications:

  • Strong ethical practice and commitment to professional responsibility;

  • Confident, talented, independent and highly motivated with the ability to accept significant responsibility;

  • Positive attitude and self-starter;

  • Excels in a fast-paced, demanding environment;

  • Able to successfully manage competing priorities and work independently on a wide range of issues and projects, while delivering quality work under demanding deadlines;

  • An enthusiastic, flexible team player with a great sense of humor, willing to support and able to learn from and share experiences with other members of the Alteryx Legal team.

Compensation:

Alteryx is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as your relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

The salary range for this role in the United States is $180,000 - $200,000.

In addition, you may be eligible for additional compensation, such as a bonus. Employees may also be eligible for a wide range of other benefits, including medical, retirement, financial, wellness, time off, employee discounts, and others.

Interested? Learn more and apply today at alteryx.com/careers!

Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? At Alteryx, we support a growth mindset for our associates through all stages of their careers. If you meet some of the requirements and you share our values, we encourage you to apply. As part of our ongoing commitment to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, we’re invested in building teams with a wide variety of backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

raw.description:
Retrieval Operations Lead

Remote

About Reveleer

Reveleer delivers a unified platform spanning risk adjustment, quality improvement, clinical intelligence, and member management for health plans and provider organizations navigating the complexity of value-based care. Trusted by 80+ customer organizations nationwide, the platform integrates data, analytics, and intelligent workflow automation into one governed system designed to support traceable documentation across diagnoses, quality measures, and submissions. With regulatory expertise and transparent, human-in-the-loop AI at its core, Reveleer supports organizations working to advance care quality, strengthen documentation integrity, and sustain the operational readiness needed to navigate audits with confidence.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Retrieval Lead drives frontline execution of Reveleer's retrieval program, covering approximately 500,000 chases beginning with the October 2026 go-live.

This role owns the day-to-day relationship with the program's largest AIDs, distributes and rebalances chase work assignments across the PSR team, and trains new and existing PSRs on retrieval workflows, standard processes, and provider outreach best practices.

This role is the first line of response for provider escalations, resolving access and outreach issues directly and escalating only what requires the Retrieval Manager's involvement.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Large AID Relationship & Provider Contact

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a program's highest-volume AIDs, maintaining direct relationships with provider office staff.
  • Monitor retrieval performance for large AIDs and proactively address barriers before they affect chase completion.
  • Coordinate directly with provider offices on record request logistics, portal access, and recurring retrieval issues.

Work Assignment & Queue Management

  • Distribute and rebalance daily chase assignments across the PSR team based on AID priority, chase age, and retrieval deadlines.
  • Monitor individual PSR workloads and adjust assignments to keep the queue moving and prevent aged chases from stalling.
  • Partner with the Retrieval Manager on weekly volume planning and flag capacity gaps before they affect throughput.

PSR Training & Development

  • Onboard and train new PSRs on chase workflows, AID ownership, pend code handling, and platform agent hand-offs.
  • Deliver ongoing coaching and refreshers on retrieval best practices, call quality, and documentation standards.
  • Maintain training materials and job aids, updating them as workflows or systems change.

Provider Escalation Management

  • Own first-line resolution of provider escalations related to retrieval outreach, record requests, or access issues.
  • Document escalation patterns and root causes and recommend workflow or script changes that reduce recurring issues.
  • Escalate unresolved or systemic provider issues to the Retrieval Manager with a clear summary and recommend next step.

Performance Monitoring & Coaching

  • Track individual and team-level retrieval rate, pend rate, and productivity against program targets.
  • Provide day-to-day feedback and coaching to PSRs based on chase outcomes and call quality.
  • Flag underperformance or training gaps to the Retrieval Manager and support corrective action plans.

Process Adherence & Documentation

  • Ensure PSR adherence to standard retrieval processes, procedures, and documentation requirements.
  • Maintain accurate, current records on AID assignments, escalation status, and chase ownership.
  • Support the Retrieval Manager with input on process updates and standard operating procedure revisions.

ABOUT YOU:

  • 2+ years of experience in healthcare operations, chart retrieval, risk adjustment, or HEDIS/quality program support.
  • 1+ years of experience training, coaching, or leading the daily work of other individual contributors.
  • Working knowledge of risk adjustment and HEDIS retrieval workflows, including chase, AID, and pend code concepts.
  • Experience managing provider-facing communication, including resolving access or outreach escalations directly.
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage and rebalance work assignments across a team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in Excel and comfort working within chase or case management systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience delivering training or coaching.

Preferred

  • Direct experience supporting Medicare Advantage or ACA health plan retrieval programs.
  • Prior experience formally training or onboarding new hires in a call center or retrieval operations setting.

WHAT YOU’LL RECEIVE:

•Competitive salary 

•• Medical, Dental and Vision benefits 

•• 401k match

•• Generous PTO plan 

  •  Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

•Reveleer E-Verifies all new hires.

  • Reveleer is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law.
Salary: $21 – $28 / hour

WHO WE ARE:

Boston Imaging, a subsidiary of Samsung Electronics Co. Ltd., develops, manufactures, and markets innovative imaging technologies and is committed to delivering fast, easy, and accurate diagnostic solutions to healthcare providers. Boston Imaging is the US headquarters for sales, marketing, service and distribution of all Samsung digital radiography and ultrasound systems. Our advanced medical technologies are used worldwide in leading healthcare institutions, helping providers enhance patient care, improve patient satisfaction, and increase workflow efficiency. Samsung is committed to being a leader in the field of healthcare imaging.
Samsung is a growing presence in the radiology field and is committed to delivering fast, easy and accurate imaging solutions to healthcare providers. The full range of Samsung imaging solutions includes Ultrasound, Digital Radiography, and mobile Computed Tomography (mCT). Samsung aims to become a global leader in the medical imaging space and is investing heavily in developing innovative, advanced imaging technologies that will improve the quality of people's lives.
Samsung keeps a constant eye on the always-evolving, ever-changing imaging industry. By continually enhancing current product lines and seeking to develop new technologies, Samsung is at the forefront of the imaging frontier.

ROLE DESCRIPTION:

Responsible for escalated onsite support for our premium ultrasound imaging products within the tier one hospital networks; Represent Samsung as the subject matter expert in Ultrasound and serve as the “go to” resource for difficult service issues; This position is remote and/or office based. This position works from an assigned strategic region within the United States supporting Samsung channel partners and end users; Develop strong relationships with the end users and participate in the sale of both new systems and service contracts. This position is unique requiring both highly technical skills and participation in the sales process, it is both tactical and strategic, which will be essential to the success of the sales growth of high-end ultrasound products. This position will also be responsible for providing direction and assistance to “generalist” field service engineers either contracted or direct/dealer employees.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned

  • Serve as customer facing senior technical resource and work in collaboration with biomed engineers and other senior staff members at the tier one hospitals
  • Use effective troubleshooting techniques to respond to complex technical issues for the end user. Identify problems and coordinate appropriate corrective and preventive action
  • Conduct periodic meetings with the end user to develop a strong working relationship and to ensure customer satisfaction
  • Manage escalated technical issues in a timely and effective manner. Ensure escalation situations are managed and corrected quickly and professionally
  • Stay current with product changes and specifications by periodic visits to Head Quarters in South Korea
  • May provide on-call support coverage via a call rotation schedule as needed
  • Supervise and train less experienced staff
  • Prepare monthly activity reports with specific technical issues and resolutions
  • Log all support issues and information into the call center database
  • Present to the customer the Samsung story and service strategy during the sales presentation
  • Present a positive, professional image that reflects well on Samsung
  • Self-directed, able to prioritize and effectively handle multiple service issues at one time in high pressure situations which requires a cool and professional manner
  • On-site troubleshooting and resolving complex technical problems on Ultrasound equipment in a medical environment
  • Drive customer satisfaction through service excellence by conducting preventive maintenance, managing repair/parts cycle times
  • Have a very high level of product knowledge
  • Build a service data base of information to align with our corrective action systems
  • Run tests and simulations at our facility to assist with problem solving
  • Travel to the field to train and or resolve customer issues
  • Attend and complete all required training and certification exams
  • Learn to be proficient in service and repair of all systems (current, new, and updates)
  • Be able to work independently and take ownership of customer base
  • Be completely self-sufficient in the field
  • Manage time effectively; prioritize and make good business judgments and decisions in relationship to efficiency, effectiveness while meeting daily service expectations
  • Become and remain compliant with any required credentialing services (this includes, but is not limited to, passing a drug screen(s) and background check(s))
  • Follow all company policies regarding travel, expenses, meetings, and meals
  • Maintain basic system operational and service understanding in order to answer customer questions and resolve issues independently
  • Maintain service calendar accessible by CS Manager/staff
  • Close reports to CSD on Great Plains, PM Reports, Service Reports
  • Required to wear dosimeter when in direct contact with radiation emitting devices

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Technical degree in electrical or software engineering, or other related discipline or equivalent experience preferred
  • 10 plus years in field service preferred
  • Exceptional customer service skills with expertise in troubleshooting, diagnosing and solving complex technical issues
  • Must be able to be compliant with hospital credentialing requirements
  • Wide degree of creativity, leadership, and latitude is expected
  • Relevant and demonstrable technical support service experience in the Ultrasound environment
  • Strong working knowledge of Ultrasound hardware and software operating systems
  • Ability to work professionally with all levels of hospital organization staff
  • Excellent organizational, time management, written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to complete multiple tasks with minimal direction
  • Ability to travel 75% of the time
  • ISO, FDA, CMDR Awareness Training and Product Complaint System, or Certification – Health Stream
  • Experience with mechanical devices, tools and test equipment, telecommunications systems, and working knowledge of computer networking
  • Must demonstrate fluent English verbal and written communication skills and work effectively in a demanding, fast paced environment
  • Willing to travel overnight
  • Valid driving license and satisfactory driving record is mandatory and background and drug testing (pre and post-employment) is required
  • Budget, expense, and resource management experience required
  • Must be able to assemble facts from various areas, analyze data, and provide informed recommendations to management Position is administered in an extremely fluid, fast paced, at time high pressure, with multiple high priority demands.
  • The employee is exposed to various business environments such as: extremely busy hospitals or clinics where down time creates stress for the business and the patient

COMPUTER SKILLS

  • You must be comfortable with technology, and be able demonstrate proficiency with MS Office package, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, as well as Outlook, Internet Explorer, and Google Chrome

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Regularly lift and /or move up to 25 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 40-60 pounds
  • Frequently required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and talk or hear
  • Must be able to sit and/or drive for long periods of time when travelling
  • Regularly exposed to wet or humid conditions (non-weather); fumes or airborne particles; toxic or caustic chemicals; outdoor weather conditions; extreme cold (non-weather) and extreme heat (non-weather).
  • Interaction with x-ray devices; for this reason strict safety and tracking programs are in place, requiring the utilization of dose monitoring equipment either full time or as necessitated by situation
  • The noise level in the work environment is occasionally very loud.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include Close vision, Distance vision, Peripheral vision, Depth perception and Ability to adjust focus

COMPETENCIES

  • High attention to detail
  • Understanding of terminology and ability to share and communicate effectively within the group
  • Ability to organize and prioritize tasks resulting in consistent productivity
  • Ability to function within and support a team environment and build strong working relationships
  • Dependable and punctual
  • Ability to meet accuracy and productivity goals
  • Good problem-solving skills, ability to evaluate situation and prioritize factors in decision making
  • Self-motivated, utilize available resources for self-improvement and development
  • Flexible: able to follow directives and accomplish tasks outside of normal duties

About Boston Imaging

Located North of Boston in Danvers, MA, NeuroLogica Corporation, who does business in the Ultrasound and Digital Radiography space as Boston Imaging, is a subsidiary of Samsung Electronics who develops, manufactures and markets innovative medical imaging equipment for healthcare facilities and private practices worldwide. As a fast-moving, entrepreneurial company, Boston Imaging is a rapidly growing presence in the medical imaging field and is committed to delivering fast, easy and accurate imaging solutions to healthcare providers. raw.description:
Legal Counsel (m/f/d)

Remote Europe

Hello 👋 I’m Robert, Finance & Legal Lead at Kayzen and I’m now looking for a Legal Counsel to join our team. As we scale our business globally — managing an increasingly complex client and vendor landscape, navigating cross-border data privacy requirements, and growing our equity and corporate structure — we need a sharp, pragmatic, and commercially minded legal mind to own our legal function. You will take what we have built so far and professionalise, scale, and strengthen it. Working closely with our Finance & Legal Lead, you will be a true business partner to senior leadership across the company.

About Kayzen

Kayzen is an App demand-side platform (DSP) dedicated to democratizing app advertising on Mobile and Connected TV devices. We enable leading apps, agencies, media buyers, and brands to run programmatic customer acquisition, retargeting, and brand performance campaigns through our self-serve and managed service options. Built on the three core pillars of performance, transparency, and control, Kayzen powers the world’s best performance marketing teams with bespoke solutions that fuel business growth and deliver a competitive advantage. With an unprecedented scale of 300B+ daily ad requests from 1.6B+ unique users worldwide, we serve up to 1B+ ads per day in 180 countries. Kayzen is accessible through our APIs and user interface.

The team

You will join a small, senior team and work directly alongside our Finance & Legal Lead. Your key stakeholders will be the leadership team, as well as our Finance, Operations, and Commercial functions across a globally distributed organisation.

The role

As Legal Counsel, you will be Kayzen’s primary legal owner across four core areas. You will operate as a trusted business partner — not just a gatekeeper — and are expected to move fast, apply sound commercial judgment, and help the business scale without unnecessary legal friction.

Responsibilities

GDPR & data privacy compliance

  • Own and continuously develop Kayzen’s GDPR compliance programme as an AdTech company operating across multiple jurisdictions, with a particular focus on EU and US privacy frameworks
  • Advise on data processing agreements, privacy notices, consent frameworks, and cross-border data transfers
  • Act as primary point of contact for internal privacy questions

Transaction advice & contract negotiations

  • Provide legal counsel on T&Cs and related transactions
  • Lead or support contract negotiations with clients and vendors, including MSAs, SaaS agreements, partnership agreements, and NDAs
  • Ensure commercial contracts are legally robust and aligned with company risk appetite

Cap table & corporate law

  • Manage and maintain Kayzen’s cap table
  • Oversee corporate governance across Kayzen’s group structure, including subsidiary management, shareholder resolutions, and notarial filings under German law
  • Support fundraising and investor relations from a legal and corporate perspective

General compliance

  • Further develop and scale Kayzen’s compliance framework to match our growth as an internationally operating company
  • Monitor relevant regulatory developments (ad-tech, data privacy, employment, corporate) and translate them into actionable guidance for the business

Requirements

  • Qualified lawyer (“Volljurist”) or Business lawyer (“Wirtschaftsjurist”) with 2–5 years of relevant professional experience
  • Strong understanding of German business law is essential; additionally solid understanding of international and US legal frameworks, particularly in the context of data privacy and commercial contracts
  • Strong knowledge of GDPR and European data protection law; familiarity with US privacy regulations (CCPA etc.) a strong plus
  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is strongly preferred — you know how to work lean, move fast, and prioritise pragmatically
  • Hands-on experience with contract drafting and commercial negotiations across a variety of agreement types
  • Familiarity with cap table management and corporate governance in a VC-backed or founder-led company context

Deadline to apply is November 1st, 2026!

As an intern at Gamebreaking Studios, you’ll get the opportunity to grow your game development skills in a passionate and highly collaborative environment. We’re looking for someone passionate about games to use their skills to make an impact on our Internal Games Team, which is currently working on Dungeon Rampage! This listing covers all non-engineering development disciplines. If you consider yourself to be an engineer, either backend or gameplay focused, please apply through the other engineering specific listing on our careers page!

In this internship, you’ll be primarily working on our Dungeon Rampage game or other potential internal game projects. Dungeon Rampage is a revival of a popular hack and slash flash game, engineered for Steam with some new improvements. On the Dungeon Rampage team you could be helping create new features, polish the play experience, fix important bugs, or creating other kinds of new content. Your contributions will directly contribute to the happiness of our players! Our Internal Games Team is focused on working on games that we as Gamebreaking own and are in charge of creating either independently or in partnership with a publisher.

At Gamebreaking, helping the growth of our interns is a top priority. We have a strong history of our interns being successful in the games industry both inside and outside of Gamebreaking. You will be paired with a highly experienced mentor to help guide your development throughout the program, as well as managerial resources to get you all the support you may need. We want to bring people onto our team who are hungry to grow and excited to make a big impact.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the skills listed here. We understand that your qualifications may shine through in different ways and can be based on unique perspectives and experiences.

Gamebreaking Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity, and are committed to maintaining a safe and inclusive environment for our team.

We do not use AI to screen our candidates, and we encourage you not to use AI as part of your application or cover letter so your personality can shine!

Duration and Employment Status

We are a fully remote working environment seeking current students, recent graduates ~1 year out of universities, or those with similar experience to join our company. This is an entry-level position with no prior work experience required, though candidates with prior work experience will be considered.

This position is a paid internship between 3 and 6 months duration, with the possibility of a direct hire to full-time at its conclusion. We seek a candidate able to work a minimum of 30 hours per week, with a preference for 40 hours. Candidates must be able to start work no later than January 12th, 2027. Otherwise, the duration and timeframe of this internship are flexible depending on the candidate and their situation.

Benefits and employment duration may differ based on student status and country-specific laws

Desired Skills & Qualifications

  • A passion for games and entertainment that shows. Whether you love video games, board games, cosplay, or freeze tag — we want to know! If it doesn’t shine through your resume (e.g. work, academic, or community experience), please submit a cover letter.
  • 2+ years of experience in your discipline (academic or demonstrable personal projects are acceptable)
  • Enrolled in, or recently graduated from, a university program or an equivalent program focused on Game Development or equivalent.
  • Self-motivated and willing to work in multiple areas of game development
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills

Pluses

  • Worked on a game project with a team of developers before
  • Any showable game projects, or portfolios of your work

Your responsibilities

  • Be hungry to learn and grow
  • Show strong initiative when planning and executing your tasks.
  • Clearly communicate progress on tasks with other team members
  • Regularly contribute to team meetings and rituals.
  • Speak up and improve our company culture where possible!

Our Responsibilities to You

  • Encourage healthy working hours, PTO, and a respect for your time
  • Foster an environment of equal opportunity, treatment, and inclusion
  • Create a fun and playful environment that remains professional and respectful
  • Grow our culture positively and meaningfully through a high level of transparency and thoughtful conversation
  • Provide opportunities and support for you to learn and grow

About Gamebreaking

Gamebreaking Studios is a young, growing, LA-based company founded by technology leaders from around games, entertainment, and software. We found early success providing work-for-hire to other studios and now build everything from end-to-end games to online game platforms to individual feature integrations. We also develop our own games and IP alongside other projects.

Our mission: We aspire to make games and media so fun that it improves people's relationships and behaviors. We believe that making fun-first games enables us to have a positive impact. We believe deeply in our core values and hope to find people who share them:

  • Take Responsibility
  • Raise The Tide, Not One Boat
  • Ambitious Goals, Disciplined Execution
  • Design For People, Own Your Craft
  • We Play Together

Working at Gamebreaking as a non-US citizen

This position is open to candidates living and working in Latin America. Applicants must be fluent in English, willing to work according to US time zones (must be available 8am - 3pm Pacific Time), and have a strong, stable internet connection conducive to remote work and video calls. Outside the US, we work with an Employer of Record ( to hire employees and contractors.

description: GROW WITH US: Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience.

raw.title: Demand Planner Manager
raw.excerpt: GROW WITH US: Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience.
raw.description:
GROW WITH US: Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.

STAY AWESOME: Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with type 1 diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

At Tandem Diabetes Care, we are creating new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and healthcare providers through a positively different experience.

We are looking for a Demand Planer Manager to join our International team. This role is based in the Netherlands and offers a remote working arrangement. The successful candidate should be willing and able to travel regularly to other international locations as required to support business needs.
In this influential role, you will lead demand planning, forecasting, inventory allocation, and operational coordination across Tandem’s international distributor and direct markets. You will help align customer demand, product availability, revenue expectations, and fulfilment plans while strengthening the processes and partnerships that support our continued international growth.

STAY AWESOME:

Tandem is dedicated to making diabetes technology more intuitive, innovative, and human. We combine advanced technology with a personal connection to our mission, always keeping the needs of people living with diabetes at the heart of what we do.

As our Demand Planer Manager, you will turn market insights and commercial priorities into clear, actionable demand plans. Working across Commercial, Supply Chain, Finance, Operations, Marketing, Regulatory, and distributor partners, you will help identify risks early, optimise inventory, and ensure international markets are ready for product launches and changing customer needs.

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

In this role, you will:

  • Own the monthly demand planning and forecasting process for Tandem’s international distributor partners and direct markets.

  • Consolidate market forecasts and analyse forecast accuracy, bias, demand variability, purchasing patterns, and emerging trends.

  • Establish effective planning rhythms, including monthly reviews with direct markets and quarterly demand reviews with distributor partners.

  • Lead and participate in S&OP discussions covering demand, inventory health, service levels, purchasing patterns, and operational risks.

  • Build strong partnerships with country leadership and distributor teams to gather real-time market intelligence, commercial insights, competitive developments, tender opportunities, and launch information.

  • Challenge assumptions and investigate material forecast changes, demand spikes, demand erosion, inventory imbalances, and unusual ordering trends.

  • Create consensus demand plans that balance market expectations, inventory availability, supply constraints, financial objectives, and operational capabilities.

  • Align forecasts with open orders, shipment plans, product availability, and fulfilment expectations in partnership with Operations Specialists, Logistics, Fulfilment, and Supply Chain.

  • Support new product introductions, software releases, product enhancements, and discontinuations by developing market-specific forecasts, inventory strategies, and transition plans.

  • Identify ageing, excess, or potentially obsolete inventory and work with international markets to develop mitigation and depletion strategies.

  • Lead demand allocation planning during supply-constrained situations, taking account of customer impact, tender commitments, launches, available inventory, and market requirements.

  • Partner with Finance on revenue planning and help develop dashboards and reporting covering forecast performance, inventory exposure, order trends, and revenue projections.

  • Present demand, inventory, and fulfilment insights to Commercial and Operations leadership.

  • Improve planning tools, reporting, operational workflows, automation, and analytics to increase forecast accuracy and operational efficiency.

  • Provide leadership, coaching, development, and performance management to Operations Specialists.

  • Set team priorities, support cross-training and succession planning, and create a culture of collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

The position may require flexibility to collaborate across international time zones and independent international travel of up to 25%.

EXTRA AWESOME:

You will bring:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Operations Management, Finance, or a related field.

  • At least six years of experience in demand planning, supply chain planning, sales operations, inventory planning, or commercial operations.

  • Strong knowledge of forecasting, demand planning, inventory management, allocation, and supply chain processes.

  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the confidence to assess complex supply-and-demand scenarios and make data-informed recommendations.

  • Financial and commercial acumen, including an understanding of revenue forecasting.

  • Experience collaborating across Commercial, Finance, Operations, and Supply Chain functions.

  • Strong communication, presentation, influencing, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to communicate insights to leadership audiences.

  • Fluent spoken and written English.

  • The ability to manage multiple priorities in an international, fast-moving, and evolving environment.

It would be especially valuable if you also have:

  • Experience supporting international markets, distributors, or complex fulfilment networks.

  • Experience working in a global or distributor-based commercial organisation.

  • Familiarity with CRM, ERP, order-management, Salesforce, or Microsoft Dynamics environments.

  • Experience supporting product launches, lifecycle transitions, inventory allocation, or constrained-supply planning.

  • Experience leading, coaching, and developing operational team members.

  • Fluency in an additional European language.

If your experience does not match every point, we still encourage you to apply. We value transferable skills, different perspectives, and the potential to grow.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

You will join an international, high-tech MedTech environment where your work will directly influence product availability and operational performance across multiple markets.

You can expect stimulating work in an innovative field, meaningful autonomy, excellent working conditions, and the opportunity to collaborate with motivated colleagues across Tandem’s international organisation. You will also have the opportunity to shape scalable planning practices, strengthen team capabilities, and contribute to successful product launches and international growth.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:
At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome!

BE YOU, WITH US!

We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us.

Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.

REFERRALS:
We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share!

Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow.

ProPharma partners with its clients through an advise-build-operate model across the complete product lifecycle. With deep domain expertise in regulatory sciences, clinical research solutions, quality & compliance, pharmacovigilance, medical information, and R&D technology, ProPharma offers an end-to-end suite of fully customizable consulting solutions that de-risk and accelerate our partners’ most high-profile drug and device programs.

The Central Monitoring Associate position is responsible for providing support to the clinical monitoring teams while utilizing centralized data and reporting tools in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Regulatory requirements, ICH and GCP guidelines and study specific plans.

Essential Functions:

  • Performs remote site monitoring and management activities for assigned project(s) in accordance with FDA and/or local regulations and guidelines, ICH GCPs and ProPharma Group SOPs and project plans.
  • Supports study monitoring team in implementing study strategies, initiatives, and processes and standards, to ensure consistent, efficient, and quality processes to meet quality, and study delivery within the expected timelines.
  • Supports collection of data, and report generation to support activities such as recruitment plan, and enrollment, drug supply status, site payment status, and any other relevant tracking to support successful clinical trial execution.

raw.excerpt: About the RoleAbnormal AI is seeking a Product Manager (Outbound) who builds the field motion from the ground up for every new product launched.
raw.description:
About the Role

Abnormal AI is seeking a Product Manager (Outbound) who builds the field motion from the ground up for every new product launched. There is no universal playbook, no inherited demo flow, and no proven messaging to hand off. Each new product requires its own: this person architects it, validates it in close partnership with the field, and hands off a repeatable motion the field can run at scale before moving to the next product launch.

Outbound Product Management (OPM) is R&D's operating layer in the field, the function that sits between what we build and how it performs with customers. That means being first in on a new product, before anyone has figured out how to sell or demo it, running structured validation across customer accounts, and distinguishing a product gap from a positioning or sales-motion gap. You'll work in close partnership with Product Management and Product Marketing—OPM owns the field motion, not the roadmap, but the pattern analysis and positioning work you bring back is what keeps both teams calibrated to what's actually happening with customers.

This is not a feedback-intake role. You'll be operating on products that don't have established answers yet — the messaging is still being proven, the competitive positioning is still being tested, and the product itself may still be taking shape. You'll know when a read is solid enough to bring back to the cross-functional team versus when it needs more digging, and you'll drive the motion forward without waiting for someone to hand you a map.

What You'll Do

  • Architect the field motion for an assigned product launch: design how the product gets demoed, how a POV gets structured, and what the field needs to run it at scale — then get hands-on with customer discovery, deep dives, and POVs to validate the approach.
  • Test and refine messaging hypotheses in live deals alongside Sales Engineers, and diagnose competitive loss reasons.
  • Brief PM with pattern analysis across accounts, distinguishing a product gap from a positioning or sales-motion problem.
  • Partner with Product Marketing as a standing collaborator, stress-testing messaging in live deals and reporting what's landing versus what needs to change.
  • Own the handoff at General Availability: document what worked, what broke, and what the field needs to run the motion independently — then move to the next product and do it again.

Must-Have Skills

  • 5+ years in Product Management or Solutions/Sales Engineering in enterprise security.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently synthesize unfamiliar products quickly — given a new product and limited context, you can identify what matters, form a hypothesis, and start building the field motion: how the product gets demoed, how a POV gets structured, and what the field needs to run it at scale.
  • Experience working in a pre-launch or early-stage product environment before a playbook existed, with a specific program, motion, or deliverable built from scratch to show for it.
  • Credibility that speaks through work and presence, and the instinct to move toward problems before they're assigned.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; credible in front of technical buyers and security teams, equally comfortable in a live customer conversation and an internal roadmap review.
  • High operational excellence and ownership: you've taken a field observation from raw signal to a documented recommendation that a PM or GTM team acted on.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the capacity to reason through ambiguous problems and move to a working hypothesis without waiting for the full picture.

Nice to Have

  • Prior involvement in new product launches, design partnerships, early-access, and/or beta programs.
  • Experience running or presenting in structured cross-functional forums (POV reviews, launch/GTM syncs).
  • Familiarity with enterprise security platforms such as CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Zscaler, Wiz, Microsoft, or similar.
  • Comfort using AI tools to synthesize patterns across large sets of qualitative input (support tickets, call transcripts, win/loss notes).
  • Prior startup experience.

Why This Role Matters

This role is a career inflection point. It’s a senior seat with real organizational weight that will set a new standard for the team around you. The people who thrive here carry credibility on arrival—they've been in enough high-stakes customer and cross-functional environments that they don't need to win the room before the work begins. If you come from a product management background, this is where you build the GTM fluency that traditional PM roles don't give you, and that fluency is increasingly what separates good product people from exceptional ones. If you come from a solutions engineering background, this is where technical credibility becomes strategic ownership. Either way, you'll be at the frontier of what we're building, working on products that don't have all the answers yet, shaping the motion before anyone else has, and coming out the other side with a profile that's genuinely hard to replicate elsewhere. The launches you'll be working on aren't side bets—they're the company's biggest bets for our next phase of growth, and this role is at the center of bringing them to market.

Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

Alteryx is searching for a Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security. This position is remote-friendly.

Position Overview:

The successful candidate will serve as a primary legal advisor on privacy, data protection, information security, and AI matters, with a principal focus on leading complex customer and vendor negotiations involving these specialized requirements. Candidates for this position will be qualified lawyers with strong transactional experience and in-house experience within the technology sector, preferably in software and multiplatform environments (on-premises, native SaaS, and hybrid solutions). Candidates should be skilled and enthusiastic users and learners of AI tools as part of their day-to-day legal responsibilities. The ideal candidate will thrive as an independent self-starter with significant autonomy in a fast-paced, business- and results-oriented environment.

Primary Responsibilities:

Customer Contract Negotiations

  • Lead negotiations and escalations involving privacy, data protection, information security, AI, HIPAA, and other specialized legal and regulatory requirements.

  • Develop practical positions that address legal risk while supporting customer relationships and timely deal closure.

  • Communicate complex legal and regulatory concepts clearly to internal audiences, and effectively convey Alteryx’s position to customers, their counsel, and their privacy and security teams.

  • Anticipate objections and recurring points of friction, and resolve them independently or in collaboration with peers and senior staff.

Vendor Contract Negotiations

  • Review and negotiate vendor terms involving privacy, security, AI, HIPAA, data use, and other specialized requirements.

  • Coordinate with Procurement, Information Security, business owners, and other Legal teams to assess risk, establish appropriate safeguards, and resolve escalated issues.

Contract Templates and Legal Standards

  • Create and maintain standardized agreements, addenda, and supporting materials, including the Customer DPA, Vendor DPA, Customer Information Security Program Description, Vendor Security Standards, HIPAA Business Associate Agreement, customer AI terms, and vendor AI terms.

  • Update templates to address regulatory developments, negotiation experience, and changes in Alteryx products and operations.

Public-Facing Privacy and Trust Documentation

  • Develop and maintain customer-facing privacy, data-use, security, and compliance materials.

Policies, Playbooks, and Legal Enablement

  • Develop and maintain internal policies, negotiation playbooks, and practical guidance. Translate legal requirements and approved risk positions into repeatable processes that enable consistent decision-making across Legal and the business.

Your Background:

  • A qualified attorney admitted to practice in one or more states in the United States and a member of one or more state Bar(s) in good standing, with a license to practice law within the state employed;

  • Seven-plus years of experience as in-house counsel (law firm experience helpful but not required);

  • Substantial experience negotiating privacy, data protection, and information security terms in enterprise software transactions, on both the customer and vendor side;

  • Deep working knowledge of global privacy and data protection law (including GDPR, U.S. state privacy laws, and international transfer mechanisms), information security requirements and frameworks, HIPAA and emerging AI regulation;

  • Successful completion of one or more IAPP certifications (CIPP, CIPM, AIGP) preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience drafting and maintaining contract templates, playbooks, policies, and public-facing privacy documentation;

  • Demonstrated knowledge of best-practice internal controls, procedures, risk surveillance, and escalation;

  • Excellent oral and written, presentation and interpersonal communication skills;

  • Excellent negotiation skills;

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex legal issues and solutions to clients clearly and succinctly, and to develop credibility at all levels of the business organization;

  • Proven analytical, time management, and problem-solving skills.

Personal Qualifications:

  • Strong ethical practice and commitment to professional responsibility;

  • Confident, talented, independent and highly motivated with the ability to accept significant responsibility;

  • Positive attitude and self-starter;

  • Excels in a fast-paced, demanding environment;

  • Able to successfully manage competing priorities and work independently on a wide range of issues and projects, while delivering quality work under demanding deadlines;

  • An enthusiastic, flexible team player with a great sense of humor, willing to support and able to learn from and share experiences with other members of the Alteryx Legal team.

The salary range for this role in the United States is $180,000 - $200,000.

In addition, you may be eligible for additional compensation, such as a bonus. Employees may also be eligible for a wide range of other benefits, including medical, retirement, financial, wellness, time off, employee discounts, and others.

raw.description:
SmartLight Analytics is looking for an automation-first QA Engineer to build and own test automation across our internal tools, carrier-facing APIs, and carrier and customer portals. This is a hands-on engineering role, not a manual-testing position with automation on the side: you'll design, build, and maintain an automated test framework (e.g., Playwright) as the primary way we catch regressions and gate releases, and you'll bring AI-enabled tooling into how tests get written and maintained.

This is a remote role.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain automated regression suites (Playwright or an equivalent modern framework) covering internal tools, carrier-facing APIs, and carrier and customer portals

  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD so they run on every relevant change without manual triggering

  • Evaluate and apply AI-enabled testing tools - AI-assisted test generation, self-healing selectors, AI-assisted defect triage - to speed up authoring and maintenance while keeping a clear standard for what still needs human review

  • Act as the release quality gate for the toolsets you own: sign off on releases based on automated test results, or make an explicit, documented risk call when something isn't ready

  • Find, isolate, and clearly document defects with reproducible steps, expected vs. actual behavior, and severity

  • Prioritize test coverage by risk - carrier- and customer-facing paths, compliance-relevant flows, and high-usage features get coverage first

  • Partner closely with Software Engineering and Product throughout the development cycle so testing isn't a bottleneck bolted on at the end

  • Build and document repeatable QA practice - test architecture, coverage standards, release-gate criteria - so quality doesn't depend on any one person's memory

  • Produce testing and change-management artifacts that hold up as evidence under compliance frameworks like SOC 2

What We're Looking For

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated test suites with Playwright or a directly comparable modern automation framework (Cypress, Selenium/WebDriver, etc.)

  • Experience testing both UI and API layers, including reasoning about API contracts and data flows for integration testing

  • Experience integrating automated tests into a CI/CD pipeline

  • Practical experience using AI tooling to accelerate software testing work - test generation, test maintenance, or defect triage - with good judgment about where AI output needs verification

  • Strong defect isolation and reproduction skills; writes bug reports engineers can act on without back-and-forth

  • Sound risk judgment - can distinguish a cosmetic issue from one that threatens data integrity, compliance posture, or customer/carrier trust

  • Comfortable being a release gatekeeper: can say "this isn't ready" and back it up with evidence

  • Self-directed and comfortable building and improving automation process independently

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing systems in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment (SOC 2, HIPAA-adjacent, or similar)

  • Experience testing external-facing API integrations with third-party partners

  • Familiarity with Python and/or Snowflake-adjacent data pipelines, enough to sanity-check data quality issues surfaced during testing

  • Experience standing up or significantly leveling up an automation framework

Reporting & Team

This role sits within Software Engineering, working closely with engineering, Product, and Data Platforms, with room to grow into a broader quality engineering function as SmartLight's toolset and carrier/customer-facing surfaces expand.

Adverse Event & Safety Reporting Support

raw.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend | Germany | Remote
raw.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
raw.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

Senior Engineering Manager, Grafana Frontend

The Opportunity:

Grafana is an open-source observability product and a platform that teams and plugin developers build on. The Frontend group shapes its user experience (from dashboards and visualisation to navigation, search and sharing) and the foundations that support engineering teams and community contributors across the Grafana ecosystem.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the Frontend Platform and Navigation squads, owning their performance, delivery and customer outcomes. Frontend Platform enables teams to build reliable, high-quality experiences; Navigation helps users find and organise resources and move confidently through Grafana.

You’ll develop senior engineers, partner with Product and Design, and improve how teams work, including through AI and automation. We use Cloud-first rollout and experimentation to learn quickly, bringing relevant improvements to OSS and Enterprise.

AI Notice: We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be accountable for the performance of two distributed engineering squads: set clear expectations, delegate effectively, coach and develop each team member, give timely feedback, address performance gaps and build a culture of trust and accountability.
  • Own hiring and team planning across both squads, aligning team capacity and skills with product priorities and longer-term needs.
  • Lead discovery with your squads: engage directly with customers, community members and internal users, combine their feedback with research and usage evidence, and use those insights to shape roadmaps and priorities.
  • Partner with Product, Design and engineering leaders to set priorities, resolve dependencies and make trade-offs between customer needs, long-term investments and operational demands.
  • Own delivery across both squads from discovery through rollout and measurement: set milestones, surface risks early and intervene when commitments are at risk.
  • Use AI regularly in your management work to synthesise research and feedback, inform roadmap and resourcing decisions, and streamline coordination, reporting and follow-through.
  • Improve how the squads plan, make decisions and deliver. Lead the adoption of AI and automation across engineering and operational workflows, evaluating their impact on delivery speed, quality and time spent on repetitive work.
  • Set engineering direction with senior engineers for the frontend foundations owned by your squads, including developer experience, accessibility, architecture, tooling, reliability and multitenant capabilities.
  • Set engineering direction for navigation, search and resource organisation, including where AI-assisted discovery can help users find what they need.
  • Set and uphold engineering standards for quality, security and operability, including how teams evaluate and validate AI-assisted work.
  • Lead improvements across Grafana and R&D that increase engineering productivity and improve business outcomes.
  • Participate in the engineering management on-call rota, coordinate responses and drive improvements that reduce recurring disruption. Regularly use Grafana’s AI capabilities for observability, incident investigation and management, bringing that experience into product feedback and roadmap decisions.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Significant experience managing senior engineers, building healthy teams and developing technical leaders. You give clear feedback and address performance gaps directly and fairly.
  • A strong technical foundation in modern web or frontend systems, enabling you to evaluate technical trade-offs and shape architectural and engineering-quality decisions with senior engineers.
  • A track record of turning ambiguous, cross-team problems into clear priorities and measurable results, managing delivery risks and operational demands.
  • Strong product and customer judgement, with the ability to connect engineering investments to user, developer and business outcomes.
  • Clear, concise written communication and the ability to work effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.
  • An appreciation for open-source development and the judgement to balance Cloud-first delivery with the needs of customers, community members and internal teams.
  • Practical experience using AI and automation in your own leadership work, and leading teams to adopt them effectively.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience with React, TypeScript or comparable large-scale frontend ecosystems.
  • Experience leading a developer platform team, including support for plugins or extensions.
  • Experience with navigation, search, information architecture or resource-management products.
  • Experience delivering multitenant SaaS or major platform migrations.
  • Experience working on a widely adopted open-source product.

Compensation & Rewards:

In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is EUR 124,571- EUR 149,485. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process.

All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

raw.description:
About the Team

Our engineering team builds next-generation, cloud-native bare-metal orchestration platforms for AI neo-cloud environments. We operate on a T-shaped engineering model: while each engineer brings deep expertise in a primary domain, every team member maintains practical fluency across neighboring systems. This shared foundation enables rigorous design reviews, effective cross-domain code reviews, and dependable on-call coverage. Our development is fundamentally based on open-source projects, and contributing to them is a major part of our work.

We develop primary control plane software in Rust and Go, leverage Kubernetes operators, and foster an OpenTelemetry-first operational culture.

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong software architecture principles with understanding of Datacenter Networking and DPU architectures. Fitting into our T-shaped engineering model, you will drive the development of control planes powering high-density, high-throughput infrastructure for AI training and inference workloads. Familiarity with automated bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle management is a strong asset.

Core Responsibilities

  • Control Plane Development: Design, build, and maintain production-grade control plane microservices, custom Kubernetes operators, and robust reconciliation engines in Rust and Go.

  • Architecture & API Design: Author clear Functional (FR) and Non-Functional Requirements (NFR), architectural specs, system sequence diagrams, and clean gRPC/Protobuf and REST API schemas.

  • Network Integration: Develop custom integration modules and integrations for modern network operating systems (SONiC, NVUE, Cumulus) and DPU hardware platforms.

  • Observability & Diagnostics: Instrument services end-to-end using OpenTelemetry (OTel) traces and metrics, performing systematic root-cause analysis across polyglot distributed systems.

  • Quality & Engineering Excellence: Participate in rigorous, review-gated pull request workflows across Rust, Go, and SQL codebases while ensuring high test coverage via mock-driven testing.

Required:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in cloud-native platforms or systems programming

  • Primary mastery of Rust (Tokio async runtime, Tonic, Axum, sqlx) and proficiency in Go (secondary).

  • Concurrency & Reliability: Strong background in async concurrency models, lock-free patterns, distributed state handling, and mock-driven testing discipline.

  • APIs & Serialization: gRPC/Protobuf contract design (via tonic/prost) and schema evolution (using zero-copy serialization and compile-time type generation).

  • Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube-rs with CRD-driven reconciliation loop patterns.

  • Testing Discipline: Commitment to test-driven design, writing highly testable code with mock interfaces for external service dependencies.

  • Collaborative Architecture: Proven track record of writing crisp architectural specs and engaging in constructive, cross-functional design reviews.

Desired:

  • Advanced SQL / PostgreSQL fluency

  • Datacenter Protocols & OS: Expertise in BGP, MP-BGP, EVPN, VXLAN, L3VNI, route targets, and route server design. Hands-on experience with SONiC, Cumulus Linux, and NVUE (featuring a first-class NVUE client).

  • DPU & Fabric Ecosystem: Deep knowledge of NVIDIA DOCA, Host-Based Networking (HBN), BlueField DPU architectures, and the DPF (DOCA Platform Framework) operator model (BFB, DPUSet, DPUNode CRDs).

  • High-Performance Interconnects: Understanding of InfiniBand fabrics, NVLink / NMX-M partitioning, and RoCEv2.

  • Linux Kernel Networking: Advanced grasp of Linux netlink, network namespaces, routing tables, and internal DHCP/DNS service implementations (the project ships its own services).

  • Cloud & Kubernetes Networking: Familiarity with CNI plugins (Calico, Cilium). OVS and DPDK experience is a plus.

  • Provisioning & Boot Infrastructure: Expertise in PXE/iPXE, UEFI, Secure Boot, measured boot, and TPM attestation.

  • Hardware Management: Proficiency in Redfish, IPMI, and BMC abstractions across heterogeneous hardware platforms (Dell, Lenovo, NVIDIA reference hardware).

  • Linux Systems Internals: In-depth knowledge of boot chains, systemd, initramfs, BIOS configuration matrices.

  • Identity & Security: Practical experience with PKI, X.509 certificates, TLS, SPIFFE/SVID, Vault, KMS, Keycloak (OAuth2/JWT), and RBAC.

  • Virtualization: Experience with KubeVirt / KVM.

  • Kubernetes Control Planes: Experience writing custom controllers/operators using kube-rs or controller-runtime with CRD-driven reconciliation loop patterns.

  • Demonstrated participation or maintaining open-source systems projects

What does Mirantis offer you?

- Work with an established Silicon Valley leader in the cloud infrastructure industry;
- Work with exceptionally passionate, talented and engaging colleagues, helping Fortune 500 and Global 2000 customers implement next-generation cloud technologies;
- Be a part of cutting-edge, open-source innovation;
- Thrive in the high-energy environment of a young company where openness, collaboration, risk-taking, and continuous growth are valued;

- Professional development and training;

- Attend conferences and working groups;

- Company outings, happy hours, hackathons, and tech talks;
- Receive a competitive compensation package with a strong benefits plan.

It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to

submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities.

We are a Leader for Container Management in G2 (#2 after AWS)!

About Mirantis

Mirantis is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy.

Mirantis serves many of the world’s leading enterprises, including Adobe, DocuSign, Liberty Mutual, PayPal, Reliance Jio, Societe Generale, Splunk, and Volkswagen. Learn more at .

AI Value Engineer

Position Summary

PhoenixTeam is a remote-first organization seeking a versatile, high-impact AI Value Engineer to join our AI services team. This is not a narrow role — it’s designed for someone who thrives in ambiguity and can move seamlessly between client delivery, rapid experimentation, hands-on education, and internal capability building.

The AI Value Engineer will lead the application of generative AI to real-world challenges, particularly in complex, regulated environments, working closely with mortgage industry clients. This role calls for a proactive self-starter who can turn insight into action, operate independently, and lead engagements, experiments, and learning efforts with minimal oversight. Mortgage industry experience is preferred; candidates without it should be prepared to ramp up on the domain quickly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead client engagements to scope, prototype, and deliver GenAI-powered workflows.
  • Translate business and operational pain points into LLM-based solutions.
  • Run discovery sessions, use case sprints, and prompt engineering labs with stakeholders.
  • Stand up fast-cycle experiments and proofs of concept using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or open-source models.
  • Package successful experiments into reusable artifacts, including prompt libraries, workflows, and solution playbooks.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts, compliance, and technical partners to validate and refine concepts.
  • Facilitate live GenAI learning experiences, including intro sessions, role-based labs, and problem-solving workshops.
  • Build and deliver enablement materials such as guides, templates, videos, job aids, and micro-learning tools.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to teams navigating AI adoption, capability gaps, and workflow redesign.
  • Launch and operate internal or client-specific “GenAI Labs” to drive adoption and learning-by-doing.
  • Create frameworks that help teams explore, experiment, and socialize wins across the organization.
  • Capture real-world insights to inform product, content, and go-to-market strategies.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3–8 years of experience in consulting, product enablement, innovation, or applied business strategy.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, make decisions, and lead client work without constant oversight.
  • Hands-on experience using generative AI for real work, including building prompts, workflows, and proofs of concept.
  • Excellent facilitation and storytelling skills, with the ability to bridge business, compliance, and technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to think and act quickly in fluid environments, with strong executional follow-through.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Mortgage, fintech, or other regulated industry experience (preferred, not required — willingness to learn quickly is essential).

  • Ability to use or teach tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Notion, Airtable, Zapier, LangChain, or similar.
  • Experience in startups, consulting, internal strategy, learning & development (L&D), or innovation teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clients move from “what is this?” to “we’re using this” — with your guidance.
  • Experiments are executed, refined, and scaled into reusable solutions.
  • GenAI learning labs unlock energy, capability, and adoption across the enterprise.
  • You become the go-to expert for AI-powered business transformation, especially in mortgage.
