raw.description:
About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: Remote, US
Travel: Up to 10%, domestic or international
Job ID: 1821

The Role:

We are looking for a Lead, Talent Development to join the People team. As Lead, Talent Development, you'll be part of a cross-functional team whose mission is to lead IonQ on its journey to build the world's best quantum computers to solve the world's most complex problems.

Winning the quantum race depends on physicists, engineers and operators who get better faster than the field moves, and on managers capable of leading them. You will own how people grow here end to end: diagnosing what capability we need, designing how people acquire it, and aggregating the data to support it.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution. That means your instinct on any problem should be leverage: our managers, our own technical experts, AI, and the right vendors. You will design the system, and others will help you deliver it.

The ideal candidate is someone who ships a version one in weeks rather than quarters, is energized by ambiguity, and wants to build the playbook rather than run someone else's.

Responsibilities:

  • Own IonQ’s talent development strategy: diagnose capability and performance gaps in partnership with People Business Partners and business leaders, identify root causes beyond training, and set the priorities the company invests in.
  • Architect and ship development experiences end to end, from design through facilitation, adoption and measurement, across audiences ranging from new hires to executives.
  • Build IonQ’s leadership bench: define what great looks like for managers and leaders, and create development pathways for new managers, senior leaders and high-potential talent that accelerate readiness for greater scope.
  • Create development paths for deep technical experts, including scientists and engineers who should advance without managing people, while equipping those who move into management to lead technical teams effectively.
  • Embed AI into how employees and managers develop through on-demand coaching and practice, personalized development paths and manager tools, so that live learning time is reserved for connection and application.
  • Scale IonQ’s enablement ecosystem: activate internal experts to teach each other, own the talent development vendor portfolio and learning budget, and apply clear judgment about when to build, when to buy and when not to intervene.
  • Define and track a measurement framework covering adoption, time to proficiency, behavior change and business impact, and translate the results into insights leaders can act on.

Requirements:

  • Experience designing and shipping talent development or enablement programs within high-growth technology, engineering or similarly complex organizations, with specific examples delivered in short windows.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency across the development lifecycle, from needs analysis and content design through delivery and measurement. You have built or shipped AI-enabled learning experiences or tools, not simply used them.
  • Demonstrated judgment on when to buy, when to build and when to do nothing, with examples of each.
  • Exceptional facilitation skills, including the ability to hold a room with senior leaders and highly technical audiences.
  • Experience operating as a function of one or close to it, including a clear point of view on prioritization and what you deliberately chose not to do.
  • Strong consultative and influencing skills without formal authority, including experience partnering with senior leaders to secure sponsorship and drive adoption.
  • Ability to define meaningful development KPIs and translate outcomes into business impact rather than relying primarily on attendance or satisfaction scores.
  • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training and professional experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree or background in instructional design, adult learning theory, organizational development, or industrial and organizational psychology.
  • Experience designing development for research, scientific or engineering populations at both individual contributor and manager levels.
  • Experience preparing an organization for rapid scaling, role evolution or reskilling.
  • Experience embedding operational excellence practices, such as Leader Standard Work or Managing Daily Improvement, into leadership development.
  • Experience designing early-career, rotational or other structured talent programs.

The total compensation package includes base, bonus, equity, and a range of benefit options found on our career site.

If this role has a commission structure, the compensation range below just reflects the base compensation range.

Wage Transparency:
$128,445—$183,450 USD

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.

We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

US Technical Jobs. The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions. Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls. Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.

US Non-Technical Jobs. Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.

If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply!

raw.description:
Overview

Why AAA Life

AAA Life is a respected and trusted American brand that has been focusing on Life Insurance and Annuity Products since 1969. At AAA Life we have over 1.8 million policies where we take pride in earning the trust of our policyholders who understand our promise to be there for them – and their families – when we’re needed most. By joining the AAA Life team, you are joining a company that genuinely cares about helping each other, with a devotion to protect the lives of those around us. We embrace a diverse, equitable, inclusive culture where all associates can feel a sense of belonging and use their unique talents and perspective to influence, innovate, motivate, and thrive.

How You’ll Work

Work Solution: Remote

Relocation Eligibility: N/A

Responsibilities

What You’ll Do

Operating within AAA Life’s core values and commitment to delivering a best-in-class member experience, the Workforce Planning Consultant is responsible for forecasting demand and capacity, optimizing staffing strategies, and monitoring operational performance within the Simplified Issue Sales Unit (SISU) contact center, with extended support for DSU (Direct Sales Unit) operations. The role is responsible for workforce strategy and staffing recommendations within the contact center(s), providing operational analytics, and outlining process optimization and continuous improvement opportunities.

This role aligns workforce planning with key business drivers, including direct mail marketing campaigns, to ensure service level attainment, operational efficiency, and cost-effective resource utilization. The role partners closely with Operations, Marketing, Finance, and leadership to deliver data-driven insights and enable proactive decision-making through the following:

  • Own and continuously improve forecast accuracy through ongoing validation of assumptions, trend analysis, and refinement of forecasting models.
  • Create and maintain capacity plans that align staffing resources with forecasted demand, service level goals, productivity expectations, and budget objectives.
  • Analyze workforce metrics including forecast accuracy, occupancy, utilization, shrinkage, schedule adherence, attrition, average handle time, and service levels to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Evaluate resource capacity versus business demand and provide proactive recommendations to leadership regarding hiring, staffing levels, overtime, voluntary time off, cross-training, and workforce allocation.
  • Recommend optimal operating hours, staffing models, shift structures, flexible work arrangements, and part-time staffing strategies based on customer demand, associate availability, and business objectives.
  • Partner with Operations, Marketing, Finance, HR, and business leaders to anticipate workload impacts from new products, campaigns, organizational changes, and strategic initiatives.
  • Consult with Operations leadership by translating workforce analytics into actionable staffing recommendations that balance customer experience, employee engagement, service levels, and financial objectives.
  • Conduct scenario modeling and "what-if" analyses to evaluate the operational and financial impact of changing demand patterns, staffing assumptions, and business initiatives.
  • Identify staffing gaps and recommend schedule realignments, hiring plans, shift bids, and resource optimization strategies to maintain service level objectives.
  • Continuously evaluate workforce planning methodologies and forecasting assumptions, recommending improvements that increase forecast accuracy and operational performance.
  • Partner with operational leaders to identify performance trends, operational inefficiencies, and process improvement opportunities using workforce analytics.
  • Lead or support workforce planning initiatives that improve productivity, cost efficiency, customer experience, and operational effectiveness.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) on current and needed staffing software, ensuring the appropriate tools and functionality are in place to support an optimal staffing process.
  • Collaborate with IT and software vendors to evaluate new functionality, recommend enhancements, and support implementation of workforce management technology that improves planning accuracy and operational efficiency.
  • Support business continuity by assisting with workforce planning during system outages or operational disruptions and recommending appropriate staffing alternatives.
  • Stay current on workforce management best practices, technology advancements, and industry trends to continuously improve workforce planning capabilities.

Position Success Criteria

Skills & Core Competencies

  • Business Acumen
  • Analytical Thinking
  • Drive for Results
  • Collaboration & Communication
  • Adaptability in a Fast-Paced Environment
  • Periodic travel to home office as business dictates (1-2 times per year)

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of workforce management, workforce planning, capacity planning, or contact center analytics experience.
  • Knowledge of contact center metrics.
  • Strong attention to detail with excellent listening, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook).
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements in a sales environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years WFM experience utilizing and implementing forecasting methodologies for contact centers with multi-skill and multi-channel complexity required.
  • Experience developing long-range capacity plans.
  • Experience in effectively presenting staffing recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Operations, Analytics, or related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Operations, Analytics, or related field.
  • Advanced Knowledge of and experience with QA tools such as NICE, Calabrio, Verint, or similar as well as AI tools such as Cresta AI, etc.
  • Proven success in analytics and creative problem-solving
  • Strong organizational skills and follow-through abilities with particular attention to detail

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands and fingers to handle, or feel, talk, hear, and concentrate. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

This job requires the ability to perform duties contained in the job description for this position, including, but not limited to, the above requirements. Reasonable accommodation will be made for otherwise qualified applicants as needed to enable them to fulfill these requirements.

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

AAA Life Insurance Company does not offer immigration sponsorship for this position. This includes visa types such as H-1B, TN, and STEM OPT. Please do not apply if you currently require or may require employer-sponsored immigration support now or in the future.

raw.description:
Leidos Engineering has an opportunity for an expereinced Project Manager who will work alongside lead engineers and program managers supporting a growing clientele of construction partners. We are currently seeking a qualified applicant to provide turnkey project management services related to electric utility engineering projects throughout the United States, with local partnering opportunities in the specified location. The Project Manager will be part of an established Project Management Office within our Power Delivery Solutions division that provides consulting services to construction partners rebuilding and expanding transmission, substation, and distribution infrastructure nationwide.

As a Leidos employee, You can look forward to a fast paced, diverse work environment and flexible work hours/work arrangements, as well as managers who will encourage career development and growth opportunities, including:

  • Formal Mentorship programs

  • Learning & Development Resources

  • Continuing Education Programs

  • Leadership training & Management opportunities

As a Senior Project Manager, you can expect to:

  • Lead high functioning engineering teams on large scale utility transmission, substation, and other complex projects that operate in an EPC or other progressive model that aligns engineering and construction.

  • Lead a team of project managers to deliver comprehensive engineering design projects for electric utility clients

  • Take ownership of overall portfolio performance, including cost, schedule, and scope management

  • Drive strategic initiatives within the PMO organization, focusing on process improvements and operational efficiencies

  • Serve as the Capture Manager for large scale new business opportunities and be responsible for the preparation of major proposals, estimates, and bids documents

  • Mentor and develop project management staff, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous learning

  • Interface with clients and internal stakeholders to address issues, report progress, and mitigate risks across the project portfolio

  • Manage monthly client invoicing, accruals, and accounts receivable processes

  • Identify and pursue business development opportunities to support organizational growth

  • Ensure compliance with contract requirements and quality control standards

  • Maintain regular communication with stakeholders, including clients, project teams, subcontractors, and support personnel

  • Identify project risks and mitigation strategies

  • Travel locally and nationally as needed (roughly ~20-25%)

What you'll bring to the table (Required Qualifications):

  • 8+ years of progressive Project Management experience in the electric power/electric utility industry

  • Candidates must demonstrate experience with and comprehensive understanding of electric power and electric utility infrastructure projects

  • Knowledge of high voltage substation and transmission engineering hihgly preferred

  • Experience working with EPC (engineering, procurement, construction) Contracts will be highly preferred

  • Direct experience working with project financials, bid proposals and cost estimates

  • Direct Experience with portfolio management, contract management and risk mitigation

  • Proficiency in project management software (e.g., Workfront, MS Project, P6) and MS Office Suite

  • Strong leadership skills with a focus on portfolio management and team development

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Ability to travel periodically as required (~20%)

  • Candidates must be located in the United States in order to be considered. This position cannot be performed outside of the US

  • US Citizenship required

Other Preferred Qualifications:

  • PMP Certification or willingness to obtain within two years

  • Previous experience working in a consulting environment for US based electric utilities

  • Prior experience in a leadership position

  • Demonstrated success in leading cross-functional teams

  • Previous experience working in a consulting environment

  • Experience with PowerBI and/or visualization tools

At Leidos, we pride ourselves on being a trusted and technology-focused solutions provider. Our Power Delivery Services Team is the go-to for utilities and mobile operators who need reliable power and telecommunication expertise. We've worked with over 50 investor-owned utilities, over 160 municipals/cooperatives, and we're continuing to expand our reach. Plus, we've got an amazing group of industry-leading construction partners who help us deliver meaningful Energy Delivery Solutions. Our recognition as an industry leader has been confirmed time and time again. Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked Leidos among the Top 10 T&D Firms and Top 10 Power Firms.

PDSPM

PowerDelivery

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

September 16, 2026

For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.

Pay Range $92,300.00 - $166,850.00

Job Overview

As a Technical Writer, you will create technical documentation and content covering AI infrastructure, AI data centers, AI factories, GPU computing, cloud infrastructure, enterprise hardware, and security.

This role is ideal for someone who can understand technical specifications, architectures, implementation requirements, and infrastructure concepts and explain them clearly to IT professionals and decision-makers.

Experience in technical writing within the AI, enterprise infrastructure, or enterprise IT highly desired.

Key Responsibilities

  • Create clear, accurate, detailed technical short-form content for landing pages and product pages.
  • Create clear, accurate, and well-structured technical documentation.
  • Develop implementation guides that help technical teams understand and deploy infrastructure and solutions.
  • Research and write whitepapers covering AI infrastructure, GPU compute, cloud infrastructure, security, and emerging enterprise technologies.
  • Create product and specification content for enterprise hardware, infrastructure solutions, and technology services.
  • Write technical blog posts aimed at IT decision-makers, architects, engineers, and infrastructure practitioners.
  • Translate complex technical specifications and concepts into content that is easy to understand without losing technical accuracy.
  • Work with technical, product, engineering, and subject-matter experts to gather and validate information.
  • Research emerging technologies and industry developments relevant to AI infrastructure and enterprise IT.
  • Review technical content for accuracy, consistency, clarity, and completeness.
  • Understand technical documentation, product specifications, architecture information, and implementation requirements.
  • Use diagrams, tables, specifications, and structured information where appropriate to improve technical communication.
  • Maintain consistency in terminology, technical language, and documentation standards.

What We're Looking For

  • Native English-speaking candidates only.
  • Strong technical writing and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand and explain complex technical subjects.
  • Experience writing for IT, infrastructure, enterprise technology, or related technical audiences.
  • Strong research skills and the ability to learn unfamiliar technical subjects quickly.
  • Ability to work with technical specifications, product information, documentation, and subject-matter experts.
  • Excellent attention to technical accuracy and detail.
  • Ability to adapt writing style for engineers, IT practitioners, architects, and senior technology decision-makers.
  • Strong ability to organize complex information into clear and logical documentation.
  • Comfortable researching technologies independently and asking the right technical questions.

Relevant Technical Areas

Experience in one or more of the following is valuable:

  • AI infrastructure
  • AI data centers
  • AI factories
  • GPU computing
  • High-performance computing
  • Cloud infrastructure
  • Servers and enterprise hardware
  • Data center infrastructure
  • Cybersecurity
  • Enterprise IT
  • Virtualization
  • Infrastructure architecture

We are open to candidates with different technical backgrounds. Strong technical writing ability and the capacity to understand infrastructure technologies are more important than having experience in every area listed above.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience creating technical documentation or implementation guides.
  • Experience writing technical whitepapers or research-driven content.
  • Experience working with enterprise hardware or infrastructure products.
  • Experience writing for IT architects, engineers, infrastructure teams, or technology decision-makers.
  • Familiarity with APIs, cloud platforms, GPU infrastructure, AI/ML infrastructure, or enterprise systems.
  • Basic understanding of SEO and content optimization.
  • Experience using AI-assisted research and writing tools.

Overview

Are you a visionary cloud leader who thrives at the intersection of technology, strategy, and customer success? Do you enjoy helping enterprise organizations modernize their infrastructure, accelerate innovation, and achieve meaningful business outcomes through cloud technologies?

Connection is seeking a Principal Cloud Solution Architect to join our Cloud Center of Excellence. In this highly visible role, you will serve as a trusted advisor to enterprise clients, helping them navigate complex cloud transformation initiatives across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud Platform. You will collaborate closely with executive stakeholders, sales leaders, and technical teams to architect innovative solutions that drive business value and long-term cloud adoption.

What We Do

We calm the confusion of IT by guiding the connection between people and technology. If a customer is looking for a better way to manage their warehouse inventory, equip their workforce, or secure their data, we make it happen. All it takes is finding the right combination of tech hardware, software, cloud solutions, and support services. That’s what we do. We’re the IT Department’s IT Department.

Who We Are

Our team is made stronger by a multitude of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. It’s what makes Connection unique—what drives us to innovate and create technology solutions that stand apart from the crowd. We’d love for you to be a part of that fabric, to share your ideas and experiences with a team that thrives on fresh thinking, creativity, and helping others.

Why You Should Join Us

You’ll find supportive teammates and a rewarding career at Connection—plus great benefits. We take pride in supporting employees with a total rewards package that provides financial, emotional, and physical resources for you and your family. Our compensation, 401k plans, medical insurance, and other benefits are progressive and competitive. We value the importance of our employees’ emotional wellbeing. To support employees, we provide free therapy visits, mental health coaching and tools, and meditation resources. You’ll also enjoy a generous paid time off package that includes not only vacation and sick time, but also Wellness and Volunteer Time Off days.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Responsibilities

As a Principal Cloud Solution Architect, you will help define technology strategies for some of the most complex client environments. You won't simply recommend solutions, you'll guide organizations through modernization journeys, influence key technology decisions, and mentor fellow architects while helping shape the future of Connection's cloud practice.

  • Partner with enterprise clients to understand their business objectives, application portfolios, and technology strategies.
  • Design and architect cloud solutions leveraging Azure, AWS, GCP, hybrid cloud, and cloud-native technologies.
  • Lead strategic discovery sessions and solution workshops with executive and technical stakeholders.
  • Develop cloud modernization roadmaps that align technology investments with business outcomes.
  • Guide clients through large-scale cloud migrations, application modernization, DevOps adoption, and infrastructure transformation initiatives.
  • Ensure solutions are secure, scalable, resilient, and optimized for long-term success.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior IT leaders and decision-makers.
  • Support pre-sales engagements, solution positioning, and RFP responses.
  • Mentor architects and contribute to the continued growth of Connection's Cloud Center of Excellence.
  • Stay ahead of emerging cloud technologies, market trends, and industry best practices.

Min

USD $138,000.00/Yr.

Max

USD $179,670.00/Yr.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in cloud architecture, enterprise infrastructure, application modernization, or related technical consulting roles.
  • Current cloud certifications in Azure, AWS, and/or Google Cloud.
  • Proven success leading complex cloud transformation and migration projects.
  • Extensive experience in customer-facing, consultative technology roles.
  • Ability to engage and influence senior IT executives and business leaders.
  • Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, security, automation, and governance.
  • Experience designing enterprise-scale cloud and hybrid-cloud architectures.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly valued:

  • Cloud security and governance
  • DevOps and CI/CD automation
  • Kubernetes and container orchestration
  • Infrastructure as Code
  • Serverless computing
  • API Management
  • Cloud-native application development
  • Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity solutions
  • Data and AI platforms
  • Enterprise networking and cloud connectivity

Experience with technologies such as Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jenkins, Spinnaker, Chef, or Puppet is a plus.

Because of the possibility for fraudulent job postings on many popular job boards, please be advised that Connection will never offer a position of employment without a complete interview process and communication with a “live person".

raw.description:
At Podium, we bring AI Employees to local businesses that turn every conversation into revenue. Trusted by 60,000+ businesses across Auto, Home Services, and Aesthetics, Podium captures and converts leads 24/7, driving both new business and repeat customers.

In under 24 months, we crossed $100M in AI Agent ARR, scaling 300% year-over-year. During this time, we’ve deployed 10,000 AI employees to empower real business outcomes for our customers. Podium is building what we believe will be the most impactful AI employee ecosystem for local business.

Podium has been recognized as the Best AI Implementation by Inc. Magazine, highlighted by OpenAI for building revenue-driving AI Agents, and awarded the #1 AI Agent for Business Operations by G2.

Our growth is fueled by hiring exceptional people, holding them to high standards, and creating opportunities for them to grow and make an impact. Our operating principles guide daily behavior and ensure we hire people who will thrive at Podium. If you're hungry for growth, aligned to our operating principles, and ready to get to work, you won't find a better place to learn and accelerate your career.

About the Role:

Podium built the AI Employee local businesses now depend on to answer every lead, book every appointment, and win the moments that used to slip through the cracks. It's not a chatbot bolted onto a CRM — it's an autonomous teammate that qualifies leads, holds real conversations, and closes the loop from first message to booked revenue, 24/7.

We're looking for a Senior Director of Engineering to take ownership of our AI Agents product and turn it from a fast-growing platform into the industry-defining agent infrastructure for local business. This is a hands-on leadership role — equal parts zero-to-one builder and scale-up operator. You'll architect and ship the systems that let our agents reason, act, and get better over time, while building the team and the org-level muscle to run these systems reliably at massive scale, across thousands of customer-facing workflows and business verticals.

What you will be doing:

  • Owning the technical architecture and roadmap for Podium's AI agent platform — the orchestration layer, tool-use frameworks, memory, and reasoning systems that power customer-facing agents across every industry vertical we serve
  • Leading and growing a team of engineers building and operating production agent systems, setting the technical bar and staying hands-on in design, code, and incident response where it matters most
  • Building and maturing our evaluation infrastructure — the offline and online eval harnesses, quality metrics, and feedback loops that let us ship agent improvements with confidence instead of guesswork
  • Driving the "0 to 1" build-out of new agent capabilities and workflows, then the "1 to scale" work of hardening those systems for reliability, latency, and cost as usage grows into the tens of millions of conversations
  • Partnering closely with Product to translate business outcomes (response time, conversion, show rate, revenue recovered) into agent capabilities and prioritized technical bets
  • Partnering with Infrastructure/Platform teams to ensure agent systems are observable, cost-efficient, and resilient at scale — this includes model routing, latency budgets, fallback behavior, and guardrails
  • Working directly with customers and customer-facing teams (Sales, CS, Support) to understand where agents succeed or fail in the field, and feeding that signal back into the roadmap
  • Establishing best practices for prompt/context engineering, agent testing, safety and guardrails, and responsible deployment of autonomous systems in live customer environments
  • Representing AI Agents engineering in leadership conversations — setting a clear technical narrative, calling out risk early, and making sound build-vs-buy and model-vs-vendor tradeoffs

What you should have:

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in engineering leadership roles (Director, Head of Engineering, or equivalent scope as a hands-on lead)
  • Direct experience building and operating production LLM-powered or agentic systems — not just prototypes, but systems serving real users at real volume with real reliability requirements
  • Deep fluency in applied AI architecture: orchestration frameworks, tool-calling/function-calling patterns, RAG and context management, and the tradeoffs between latency, cost, and quality
  • A track record of building and scaling evaluation systems for non-deterministic software — you know how to measure agent quality, catch regressions, and make shipping decisions without waiting for perfect certainty
  • Experience leading both "0 to 1" builds and "1 to scale" hardening — you've stood up something from nothing and you've also kept something running under real production load
  • Strong instincts for working cross-functionally with Product, Infrastructure, and customer-facing teams, and the communication skills to align technical decisions with business outcomes
  • Genuine, hands-on fluency with modern AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as part of how you and your team build

What we hope you have:

  • Experience building agent systems specifically for customer-facing, revenue-critical workflows (sales, support, scheduling, or similar)
  • Familiarity with voice AI, conversational AI, or real-time multimodal systems
  • Experience operating in a high-growth SaaS or vertical software company, ideally one serving SMB customers
  • A point of view on the frontier of agentic AI — what's changing fast, what's overhyped, and where the real leverage is for a company like Podium

Why you'll love working here:

Podium is the best place to work to:

  • Join the leaders in AI agents — you'll be building on top of a product already trusted by 60,000+ businesses to run their AI Employee, with a real mandate and real usage to learn from
  • Unlock career-defining growth — this role owns a product area at the center of Podium's future, with the scope and visibility that comes with it
  • Build with world-class talent — join a team of engineers who ship fast, use AI tooling seriously, and care as much about outcomes as elegance
  • Make a real impact on local business — the agents you build directly help local businesses respond faster, convert more leads, and grow revenue without adding headcount

Podium is an equal opportunity employer. Podium provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status or veteran status.

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead our Core Infrastructure team. This team builds and operates the foundational compute, networking, storage, and cloud systems behind Samsara’s products. Core Infrastructure is central to the availability, scalability, security, and efficiency of our platform.

This role combines technical and people leadership to evolve Samsara’s infrastructure at scale, supporting a platform that processes more than 25 trillion data points annually. You will guide infrastructure strategy and modernization, improve reliability and operational health, and enable product teams to move faster through automation and self-service capabilities.

As a manager, you’ll lead a globally distributed team, develop senior engineers, and create clear ownership across critical infrastructure domains. You’ll work closely with engineering and security leaders across Samsara to build the infrastructure required for the company’s continued growth.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go.
  • You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes.
  • You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win – together.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a globally distributed Core Infrastructure team, raising performance, establishing clear ownership, and creating leverage through senior ICs and technical leads.
  • Own technical strategy and translate it into an integrated roadmap across compute, networking, storage, infrastructure control planes, reliability, and cloud efficiency.
  • Improve operational health by strengthening capacity management, failure isolation, observability, safe rollouts, incident learning, and sustainable on-call practices.
  • Build paved paths, automation, and self-service infrastructure that help engineering teams move faster, safely, and reliably.
  • Apply AI-enabled tools and workflows thoughtfully to improve engineering execution, operational analysis, and toil reduction.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 8+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including 2+ years directly managing software or infrastructure engineers.
  • Experience leading, developing, and raising the performance of an established engineering team.
  • A strong technical background in production infrastructure, cloud platforms, or distributed systems at scale.
  • A track record of leading complex technical initiatives and translating strategy into measurable results.
  • Strong communication, technical judgment, and the ability to create alignment across teams.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience leading infrastructure for a large-scale cloud or distributed platform.
  • Experience with multi-region public cloud, container orchestration, and declarative infrastructure.
  • Led major modernization, reliability, disaster-recovery, or cloud-efficiency initiatives.
  • Experience leading globally distributed teams.
  • Practical experience using AI-enabled tools to improve engineering effectiveness.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$154,700—$260,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. raw.title: QA Automation engineer
raw.excerpt: Newfire partners with leading global companies to drive long-term engineering transformations.
raw.description:
Newfire partners with leading global companies to drive long-term engineering transformations. On this project, we are working alongside a well-established company in the luxury retail industry undergoing a major technology shift across their digital ecosystem—including a custom e-commerce platform, multiple online storefronts, and ERP integrations. The objective is to modernize the platform and accelerate software delivery, taking release cycles from several months down to about one month.
Faster, high-confidence testing is central to this effort. Development on this project is AI-native, utilizing agentic development tools like Claude Code and CodeRabbit, with AI-assisted testing serving as a core mechanism to maximize test coverage efficiently.
About the Role
At Newfire, Quality Assistance focuses on enablement rather than serving as a downstream gatekeeper. Working under the QA Lead, you will build the frameworks, tooling, harnesses, and patterns that make it simple for every engineer to test their own work. You will extend the shared end-to-end suite across critical shopping journeys and build out automated API coverage to safeguard business operations.
Your success is measured by how effectively you enable engineers to test, rather than the number of bugs caught downstream. You will frequently map out expected feature behavior, establish documented sources of truth, and maintain test code to the same rigorous standards as production code.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, extend, and maintain test frameworks, harnesses, and reusable patterns adopted across engineering pods
  • Expand the shared E2E test suite covering critical shopping journeys while ensuring high reliability in CI pipelines
  • Perform target regression testing prior to production deployments
  • Pair directly with software engineers to elevate their unit and integration testing practices
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate test authoring, edge-case coverage, and suite maintenance
  • Triage pipeline failures, isolate flaky tests, and ensure suite execution remains trusted
  • Manage test data generation and test environments for owned suites
  • Document testing patterns, standard practices, and feature specifications as they are established
  • Participate in agile ceremonies and contribute to pull request reviews for test code

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of professional test automation experience
  • Hands-on project experience with both Cypress and Playwright (current suite uses Cypress; a migration to Playwright is under evaluation)
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript / TypeScript
  • Proven experience in API test automation
  • Proven track record of building or significantly extending test frameworks and suites from the ground up
  • Strong alignment with an enablement mindset, equipping engineers to own quality
  • Sharp exploratory instincts and comfort defining expected behavior in low-documentation environments
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted test generation and suite maintenance
  • Strong grasp of the test pyramid and proper positioning of E2E testing
  • Familiarity with Git-based workflows and CI pipelines
  • Upper-Intermediate to Advanced English (written and spoken)
  • Ability to work with significant US Eastern Time overlap (LATAM / EMEA locations)

Nice To Have

  • Experience with Java test tooling (JUnit, REST-assured)
  • E-commerce domain expertise (checkout, payment processing, user account journeys)
  • Experience managing CI-integrated test suites and resolving test flakiness
  • Exposure to performance, load, or accessibility testing

description: Position OverviewWe are looking for an Appointment Setter who can confidently engage business owners, build meaningful conversations, and create qualified sales opportunities for our team.

raw.title: Appointment Setter
raw.excerpt: Position OverviewWe are looking for an Appointment Setter who can confidently engage business owners, build meaningful conversations, and create qualified sales opportunities for our team.
raw.description:
Position Overview

We are looking for an Appointment Setter who can confidently engage business owners, build meaningful conversations, and create qualified sales opportunities for our team.

As an Appointment Setter, you will be the first point of contact for prospective child care centers and nursery businesses interested in growing their enrollment. You will identify opportunities, qualify prospective clients, build rapport with decision-makers, and schedule high-quality appointments for our sales team.

Your success will directly contribute to helping child care businesses grow while supporting the continued expansion of Childcare Marketing Group. This is more than a call-making role—it's about opening doors, building trust, and creating opportunities that lead to long-term client relationships.

Compensation

  • Salary Band: $800 per month
  • Performance Bonus: Opportunity to earn a discretionary year-end performance bonus based on individual contributions, overall performance, and company results.

Why You Should Work Here

● Work That Matters: You transform lives by connecting families who need quality child care with the providers who serve them.

● Recession-Proof Growth: An established, fast-growing company that continues to thrive while many competitors struggle.

● Leadership That Has Your Back: A supportive, attentive team that answers your questions and helps you grow, professionally and personally.

● An Owner Who Shows Up: Our owner is actively involved in the business - not just a name on the door.

● Small-Team Feel: A friendly, tight-knit environment where you are a person, not a headcount.

● Remote-First Flexibility: Work remotely while staying connected to a fast-moving, collaborative team. Buffalo-area candidates may also have opportunities for occasional in-person meetings, strategy sessions, or team gatherings.

● Top-of-Market Pay: We pay above market because we hire the best and want to keep them.

● Train to Be the Best: Access $100K+ in training, courses, and materials - enough to make you more knowledgeable than 99.9% of the account managers our competitors employ.

●A Workspace That Feels Alive: Working from home can get lonely, so our virtual Sims-like office keeps the team connected day to day.

● Quarterly Town Halls: Every quarter, you get a full state-of-the-company update, so you are never guessing where things stand.

● The Dream-On Program: Each year, our CEO grants multiple wishes pulled straight from team members' dream boards.

● 25 Days Off: A full 25 paid days off per year, because we want you to have a real life outside work.

● Paid Days to Give Back: 4 paid days a year to volunteer with any charity you choose.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will develop a strong understanding of our ideal clients, confidently communicate our value proposition, and consistently deliver qualified appointments to the sales team. Ongoing, you will be measured on:

  • Qualified Appointments: Consistently schedule high-quality appointments with decision-makers who meet our qualification criteria.
  • Pipeline Growth: Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective clients through proactive outreach and follow-up.
  • Prospect Engagement: Build trust with business owners by understanding their challenges and positioning our solutions effectively.
  • CRM Accuracy: Maintain complete, accurate, and up-to-date prospect records, communications, and follow-up activities.
  • Conversion Support: Provide the sales team with well-qualified opportunities that improve appointment attendance and sales conversion rates.
  • Continuous Improvement: Actively contribute ideas to improve outreach messaging, scripts, processes, and appointment conversion.

A Typical Week Might Include

  • Contacting prospective child care business owners through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other outreach channels.
  • Researching prospective clients and identifying organizations that match our ideal customer profile.
  • Qualifying prospects by understanding their enrollment goals, marketing challenges, and business needs.
  • Scheduling qualified appointments and coordinating calendars with the sales team.
  • Following up with warm prospects who require additional touchpoints before booking.
  • Updating CRM records, documenting conversations, and tracking outreach activities.
  • Reviewing appointment metrics and identifying opportunities to improve outreach effectiveness.
  • Participating in coaching sessions, role-playing, and ongoing sales training.

Key Competencies

  • Relationship Builder: You establish rapport quickly and make prospects feel comfortable and understood.
  • Confident Communicator: You communicate professionally, ask thoughtful questions, and guide conversations naturally.
  • Results-Oriented: You enjoy working toward goals, measuring success, and continuously improving your performance.
  • Resilient: You remain positive, persistent, and motivated despite objections or rejection.
  • Organized: You manage multiple conversations, follow-ups, and appointments without losing momentum.
  • Ownership Mindset: You take responsibility for your results and consistently look for ways to improve.

This Role Is Not for You If

  • You dislike speaking with new people every day.
  • You become discouraged by rejection or objections.
  • You prefer waiting for inbound leads instead of proactively creating opportunities.
  • You struggle to stay organized with follow-ups and CRM updates.
  • You are uncomfortable working toward measurable performance goals.
  • You prefer routine administrative work over relationship building and sales conversations.

Skills and Experience Required

  • 2+ years of experience in appointment setting, lead generation, inside sales, telesales, business development, or a similar client-facing role.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Experience engaging business owners, executives, or decision-makers.
  • Strong listening skills with the ability to uncover business needs and qualify opportunities.
  • Experience using CRM systems and sales engagement platforms to manage pipelines and prospect activity.
  • Highly organized with strong follow-up and time management skills.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote-first environment.
  • Reliable home office setup with high-speed internet and the ability to work primarily on an Eastern Time schedule.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Previous experience working in a digital marketing agency or B2B sales environment.
  • Experience selling or booking appointments for marketing, SaaS, professional services, or business consulting.
  • Experience using CRM and sales tools such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho CRM, Pipedrive, or similar platforms.
  • Experience using prospecting platforms such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar lead-generation tools.
  • Experience working with child care, education, franchise, or multi-location businesses.
  • Demonstrated success consistently meeting or exceeding appointment-setting or sales activity targets.

Work Environment

This is a full-time, remote-first position. Candidates should have a reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, noise-cancelling headset, HD webcam, and a professional home office environment. The role primarily supports North American clients and requires availability during Eastern Time business hours.

About Childcare Marketing Group

Childcare Marketing Group helps child care centers, day nurseries, and early education businesses attract more families, retain enrollment, and grow with smarter marketing. We are a fast-growing, remote-first marketing company serving clients across the U.S., U.K., and beyond.

raw.description:
Wholesale Commercial Insurance Broker;

National – Digital First Platform – Real Time Rate, Quote & Bind

Compliance at iBynd + SEMSEE has outgrown a shared responsibility. This is a full-time ownership seat. The Compliance Manager will inherit a functioning compliance program across multiple entities and a real book of carrier and vendor relationships, and will be responsible for taking both to the next level: tightening the program and putting the foundation in place for the next stage of growth. This is an individual contributor role reporting directly to the COO, working in close partnership with Finance and Accounting.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

COMPLIANCE PROGRAM OVERSIGHT

  • Take full ownership of the existing compliance program and mature it across both iBynd and SEMSEE entities — written policies and procedures, training, monitoring, internal audit, producer oversight, anti-fraud and AML obligations, and the compliance committee cadence.
  • Identify compliance gaps, prioritize them by risk, and close them. Define what 'good' looks like for this company at the next stage of scale and put the controls in place to get there.
  • Oversee state regulatory and licensing across all operating states — entity licenses, producer/P&C licenses, and surplus lines broker licenses — ensuring the company's full licensing footprint is current, accurate, and audit-ready.
  • Provide tax compliance guidance in partnership with accounting, ensuring state-by-state obligations, surplus lines tax filings, and applicable programs are properly maintained and overseen.
  • Partner with Accounting and Finance on premium trust and fiduciary account compliance — segregation of premium funds, agency-bill and direct-bill reconciliation, carrier bordereaux and producer commission accounting, and support for financial statement, carrier, and regulatory audits.
  • Work with outside tax advisors on the entity-level obligations that follow the licensing footprint — state registrations and nexus, apportionment, franchise and gross receipts filings, and 1099/1042 information reporting for producers and vendors.

CONTRACTING & CARRIER RELATIONSHIPS

  • Support our Carrier appointments, binding authority and program agreements, reinsurance treaties where applicable, MGA arrangements, and the full stack of vendor, partner, and technology contracts.
  • Serve as the primary initial point of contact for carrier counterparties, MGA/MGU partners, and third-party vendors on all contractual and relationship matters.

DIGITAL PRODUCT & PRIVACY LEGAL SUPPORT

  • Work closely with the COO on legal review of the company's digital platform with particular emphasis on privacy obligations, AI/ML governance in underwriting, and data handling practices.
  • Own the company's privacy compliance program under GLBA and applicable state privacy laws, ensuring policies, notices, and data practices are current and enforceable.
  • Partner with the technology and product teams to build legal and compliance requirements into new platform features and data initiatives from the outset.

QUALIFICATIONS

REQUIRED

• 6–8 years of compliance experience

  • Direct insurance industry experience is required — insurtech, MGA/MGU, wholesale broker, or carrier. Insurtech or digital-first distribution experience is strongly preferred — we want someone who has done this work where the platform, not the paper file, is the system of record. This is not a role for a generalist looking to learn the industry on the job.
  • Working knowledge of accounting as it applies to insurance distribution — premium trust and fiduciary accounting, commission, and the ability to read a general ledger, a reconciliation, and a carrier statement without needing them translated. An accounting degree, CPA, or time spent inside a finance function is a strong plus.
  • Hands-on surplus lines premium tax experience — multi-state filings, and the mechanics of calculating and remitting tax and fees, rather than only supervising someone who does.
  • Working knowledge of surplus lines regulation, producer licensing, and the wholesale distribution model; experience with MGA, MGU, or program business strongly preferred.
  • Experience operating a compliance program — as the owner, a key contributor, or the person who inherited and matured one.
  • Comfort in a technology-forward environment — conversant with how software, data, and AI factor into modern insurance operations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills across a wide range of audiences including regulators, carriers, underwriters, and engineers.

PREFERRED

  • Experience operating or maturing a privacy program under GLBA and modern state privacy laws.
  • CPA or Accounting Background or a professional designation such as CPCU, AINS, CIPP/US, or CAMS.
  • Familiarity with NIPR and Sircon for licensing administration, and OPTins for premium tax remittance.
  • Experience supporting a company through a state market conduct exam, a carrier audit, or a financial statement audit.
Fully Remote Role

At iBynd Semsee, we are committed to upholding the highest standards of employment practices in each jurisdiction we operate in. We ensure that all employees are fairly compensated for their work, in accordance with the provisions outlined by the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).

iBynd Semsee is an equal opportunity employer, committed to a diverse workforce. iBynd Semsee complies with federal and state law governing non-discrimination in employment practices.

Our Story

TopDog Law is not your typical law firm. We're a nationally scaling personal injury firm built for impact and growth — owning the client experience end-to-end, from marketing and intake through litigation. We believe that world-class marketing, paired with exceptional legal talent and operations, creates better experiences and outcomes for clients and the business alike.

Over the past three years, we've grown 2–3x year over year, setting a new standard on the marketing side of the personal injury space and proving what's possible when strategy, speed, and execution align. Now we're applying that same discipline and innovation to firm operations, case management, and national scale — intentionally building the infrastructure, systems, and teams to grow without sacrificing quality, culture, or accountability.

We are a fully remote team that share trust, open communication, and a commitment to doing great work. If you love ownership, thrive in a fast-moving environment, and want to help build something exceptional, you'll feel right at home here.

The Opportunity

The Pre-Litigation Operations Manager oversees the day-to-day operations of the firm’s pre-litigation team, with primary responsibility for managing Case Managers and their Team Leads and ensuring workflows run efficiently, accurately, and in alignment with firm standards. This role connects both legal teams and operations/performance, ensuring cases move smoothly from intake through litigation while maintaining quality, compliance, and productivity.

What You Will Own

Team Leadership & Management

  • Directly manage, mentor, and support pre-litigation paralegals and team leads
  • Assign workloads, monitor performance, and ensure coverage across all teams
  • Conduct regular check-ins, performance reviews, and coaching sessions
  • Assist with hiring, onboarding, and training of new paralegals and team leads
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing team culture

Pre-Litigation Operations

  • Oversee case workflows to ensure timely progression
  • Identify workflow bottlenecks and implement process improvements
  • Coordinate with attorneys to ensure paralegal support aligns with case strategy
  • Ensure accurate case documentation, reporting, and data entry
  • Process Improvement & Compliance
  • Develop, maintain, and refine standard operating procedures for pre-litigation support
  • Ensure compliance with firm policies, ethical standards, and jurisdictional requirements
  • Monitor case metrics and KPIs to evaluate efficiency and performance
  • Implement best practices to improve productivity, quality control, and client service

Process Improvement & Compliance

  • Develop, maintain, and refine standard operating procedures for pre-litigation support
  • Ensure compliance with firm policies, ethical standards, and jurisdictional requirements
  • Monitor case metrics and KPIs to evaluate efficiency and performance
  • Implement best practices to improve productivity, quality control, and client service

Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Work closely with intake, medical records, demand, litigation, and settlement teams

  • Communicate staffing needs, workload trends, and operational challenges to leadership

What You Bring

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in a law firm environment, with pre-litigation and/or litigation cases
  • Prior experience managing paralegals or legal support staff required

  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficiency with case management systems and legal software
  • Leadership and team development
  • Process optimization and operational oversight

  • Problem-solving and decision-making abilities

Who Thrives Here (Core Values)

We don't hire on resumes alone. We hire for competence, character, and mindset.

  • Embrace Change: Open to feedback, embracing change, and always asking "what's next?"

  • No-Ego Energy: Positive, professional, and solutions-oriented. Drama stays at the door.
  • Ownership: You do what you say, follow through, and treat the business like it's yours.
  • Fast & Hungry: You move with urgency, thrive under high expectations, and are motivated by growth and impact.

About VGS

VGS is building the trust infrastructure for a new era of commerce. As commerce becomes agentic, payments are increasing dramatically in volume, speed, and complexity, and the companies driving that shift need a foundation they can fully trust.

That's where VGS comes in. We're the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce. We store more than 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

Come build the platform that enables modern payments for the world's largest companies. We're helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.

Trusted Engineering That Matters

Engineering at VGS

VGS is building the platform powering agentic commerce and global payments infrastructure. VGS Engineering is the pillar that supports that vision. We create a platform that is an indispensable, ubiquitous component of our partners' payments and security infrastructure. We build and operate high-scale, reliable, and resilient systems that manage mission-critical payment data across the globe. We don't just participate in the payments ecosystem; we power it.


Our Environment & Culture

  • Modern Tooling as Leverage: We value speed and impact. To ensure nothing slows you down, we arm you with a highly consistent modern stack (e.g. AWS, Kubernetes, Java, TypeScript, Python) and world-class AI-augmented SDLC tooling. We strip away the friction so you can focus on the problems that demand creativity and judgment.

  • Ownership of Outcomes: Scaling global payments infrastructure requires individuals who take personal ownership of outcomes from day one. We look for builders who combine high agency with deep strategic alignment; channeling their urgency and relentless iteration into what matters most.

  • Mission-Critical Accountability: We power payments infrastructure for global market leaders, making system trust and integrity our core deliverable. We don't treat compliance (PCI, SOC2, ISO27001), security patching, and platform maintenance as administrative overhead—we engineer them with first-class product discipline. In payments infrastructure, reliability is not background work, it’s part of what customers buy.


Learn More: See how our engineering practices drive trust and innovation in our official blog and our reliability practices.

About the Role

We’re building payment infrastructure for a world where AI agents don’t just recommend, search, and summarize. They transact.


The Agentic API is creating the secure backend layer that enables trusted agents to initiate purchases, operate within user-approved mandates, retrieve scoped payment credentials, and complete transactions without exposing raw card data.


As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll help pioneer a new category of payment infrastructure at the intersection of AI, card networks, cryptography, and secure money movement, building clean, reliable APIs for the next generation of commerce.

What You’ll Do


  • Architect Agentic Payment Infrastructure: Lead the design and evolution of Python 3.13+ and FastAPI services powering secure, production-critical agentic payment flows.

  • Define the Core API Platform: Design APIs and domain models for card enrollment, agentic token provisioning, purchase intents, mandates, device attestation, OTP flows, confirmations, and cryptogram retrieval.

  • Own Security, Reliability & Scale: Drive architectural decisions across security, scalability, availability, performance, and developer experience for sensitive payment and cryptographic workflows.

  • Build Deep Observability: Establish consistent patterns for error handling, traceability, structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing using OpenTelemetry and Prometheus.

  • Automate Platform Provisioning: Design extensible provisioning workflows using Kubernetes APIs and Custom Resource Definitions.

  • Set the Quality Bar: Define rigorous unit, integration, acceptance, and end-to-end testing strategies for high-risk payment flows, including canary-safe production validation.

  • Lead Complex Initiatives: Lead technical design reviews, surface architectural and delivery risks early, and drive cross-functional initiatives from initial exploration through reliable production operation.

  • Pioneer AI-Native Engineering: Apply AI-assisted development and agentic workflows across the SDLC to accelerate prototyping, testing, refactoring, investigation, and delivery while maintaining a high quality and security bar.

  • Partner Across the Ecosystem: Collaborate with Product, Security, Infrastructure, Platform, and external card-network partners to translate evolving requirements into secure, scalable systems.

What You Bring

  • Ownership at Scale: 10+ years of experience taking personal ownership of outcomes in complex, large-scale distributed systems within mission-critical environments.

  • AWS & Infrastructure-as-Code: Advanced proficiency in AWS ecosystems leveraging Terraform to build reproducible environments.

  • Containerization & Orchestration: Strong, hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, and GitOps workflows (Flux, Argo, GitHub Actions).

  • Automation & Scripting: Strong coding skills in Python to automate infrastructure and build operational tools.

  • Observability Expertise: Experience implementing Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry at scale.

  • Security & Networking Foundations: Solid understanding of cloud security, API Gateways, load balancing, and network isolation, viewing security as a fundamental engineering constraint, not an afterthought.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with tokenization, payment processing, or security products

  • BA/BS degree

  • A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Experience designing mandate, credential-provisioning, authentication, attestation, or cryptogram-based workflows.

  • Experience applying AI developer tools or agentic automation to day-to-day engineering workflows.

We're looking for passionate professionals who take pride in their craft and want to help grow a team tackling some of the most critical problems in payments. People who thrive here are curious by nature, unafraid of hard problems, and motivated by the chance to build something that matters at scale.

If you're driven to make a meaningful impact, work at the leading edge of payment technology, and grow your career alongside a team that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning, you'll feel right at home at VGS.

How We Work

At VGS, we embrace a remote-first philosophy because we believe flexibility leads to great work and a healthy work-life balance. That said, if you live within 30 miles of one of our office locations, you'll be on a hybrid schedule with some in-person time, because we know there's real value in coming together.

We're not about being in the office every day. We are about connection, collaboration, and the energy that comes from a great brainstorm, a team lunch, or celebrating a big win in person.

Our Benefits

Financial and retirement

  • Competitive salary

  • 401 (k) with a 4% match and immediate vesting (applies to US only)

  • Early equity

  • Internet Stipend

  • Learning Stipend

  • Office set-up stipend (applies to US only)

Vacation and time off

Professional Development

Office life and perks

Equal Opportunity

We consider all applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, marital status, physical or mental disability, or other protected classes under all applicable local, state, and federal laws and ordinances (AA/EOE/W/M/Vet/Disabled).

Qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for this position in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.
