raw.description:
ABOUT SLATE

At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR

As Distinguished Engineer of Generative AI, you are the founding technical authority for AI at Slate. You will help envision, design and ship the GenAI platform for Slate.Auto, write code, and make architectural decisions that carry long-term consequence.

The scope covers GenAI platforms, agentic systems, robot-to-model feedback loops, and embedded AI across the factory floor. You will partner with Vehicle Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality to deploy AI where it produces measurable output.

The role reports directly to the Chief Digital and Operations Officer and carries a seat on the senior technology leadership team.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Design and own the end-to-end GenAI platform: context layer, data layer, model serving, agent frameworks, and evaluation pipelines. Architecture decisions here must hold at enterprise scale, across multiple product lines, manufacturing sites, and a growing engineering organization. This means designing for reliability, cost efficiency, and extensibility from day one, not retrofitting those properties after the fact.

  • Build Industry-Leading AI Systems. Design systems that practitioners at frontier AI labs would recognize as technically sound, applied to physical manufacturing: novel approaches to context management, agentic coordination across physical and digital systems, and model personalization on proprietary manufacturing data.

  • Drive Physical AI Across the Vehicle Program. Take AI beyond the laptop. Slate's vehicles are built in the real world, by real robots, on a factory floor that generates sensor data, failure modes, and edge cases that no benchmark captures. You will embed AI directly into manufacturing: robotic process control, computer vision for quality assurance, predictive maintenance systems, and closed-loop feedback between physical production and model behavior. The goal is to dramatically improve to design and build a new vehicle.

  • Build Slate's Proprietary Data and Context Layer. Construct a knowledge base of agentic, human, robotic, and enterprise decisions that compounds over time. Build the unified Data Layer that trains purpose-built models on real Slate decisions across the vehicle lifecycle. You are responsible for the architecture of both.

  • Ship Agentic Systems Across the Company. Deploy production-grade AI agents across vehicle engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, software development, and GTM. These are not prototypes or proof-of-concepts: they are systems that run workflows that previously required humans, at a quality level that earns trust. You will establish evaluation frameworks, guardrail standards, and observability practices that make these systems auditable.

  • Lead by Building. Recruit and grow a lean team of GenAI engineers, MLOps engineers, and applied scientists. Stay in the code: review PRs, make architecture calls, and ship alongside the team. Your technical judgment sets the quality bar.

  • Set the Engineering Standard. Establish the technical standards, practices, and hiring bar for the GenAI organization. Contribute externally where appropriate: open-source, publications, or conference talks.

  • Hands-on. You have built GenAI systems from scratch in production and you still write code. You can point to specific systems you personally designed that are running at scale today. You are not afraid to directly interact with stakeholders to understand and develop requirements.

  • An architect at scale. You have designed enterprise-level platforms that serve thousands of internal users, integrate with dozens of upstream and downstream systems, and hold up under operational stress. You know what breaks at scale before it breaks, because you have seen it break before.

  • A Physical AI practitioner (preferred). You have applied AI to physical systems: robotics, manufacturing, IoT, autonomous vehicles, or another domain where data is messy, latency constraints are real, and failure modes have physical consequences.

  • GenAI native. Deep hands-on experience with LLMs, agent frameworks, RAG, and fine-tuning. Strong opinions about what works in production, grounded in having shipped it.

  • Technically credible at the architecture level. You can translate a product requirement into a concrete system design with defensible tradeoffs, and operate effectively at the frontier of what is currently buildable.

  • Comfortable in a resource-constrained environment. You build systems that perform above their weight, make pragmatic calls under uncertainty, and move fast without accumulating architectural debt that stalls the team later.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 15+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years shipping production GenAI systems and 7+ years in a senior technical leadership role. Candidates are expected to have work that is recognized outside their own organization.

  • BS required. MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field preferred. Exceptional track record beats pedigree. Candidates without advanced degrees who have published, built widely-adopted systems, or otherwise demonstrated research-level thinking through their work will be evaluated accordingly.

  • Deep hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) and open-source model deployment at production scale.Vector databases, agent orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent), and prompt engineering for reliability, not just capability.

  • Fine-tuning and training purpose-built models for domain-specific tasks, including the tradeoff analysis between hosted APIs, open-source models, and custom training across cost, latency, and IP dimensions.

  • Evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability pipelines for GenAI in production: the ability to know whether a system is working, not just whether it is running.

  • Experience designing and deploying multi-agent systems in production, including coordination protocols, failure isolation, and human-in-the-loop escalation paths.

  • Candidates with this background will move faster in the role; those without it should expect to develop it on the job.Deploying AI systems that operate on physical hardware: robots, CNC machines, quality inspection systems, assembly line sensors, or equivalent industrial environments.

  • Computer vision systems for manufacturing quality assurance: defect detection, dimensional inspection, or process monitoring at production-line throughput.

  • Closed-loop learning systems where model behavior is updated based on physical world outcomes, including approaches to safe online learning in environments where errors have physical consequences.

  • Robot-to-model feedback architectures: designing systems where robotic process data improves model performance and model outputs improve robotic process control.

  • Familiarity with physical simulation environments (Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or similar) for model development and validation before factory deployment.

  • Sensor fusion and multimodal data handling for environments with structured sensor data, unstructured imaging, and natural language interfaces operating simultaneously.

  • Designing real-time inference pipelines with hard latency constraints and failure consequences, including edge deployment architectures that operate under intermittent connectivity.

  • Data architecture for AI at scale: modern data stacks (Snowflake, Databricks, dbt), vector stores, and streaming data pipelines that handle both batch and real-time model consumption.Cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, or Azure at the architecture level, including cost modeling, capacity planning, and the tradeoffs between managed AI services and self-hosted infrastructure.

  • Designing and owning AI platforms that serve enterprise-scale internal usage: thousands of concurrent users, dozens of integrated systems, and SLA requirements that real operations depend on.

    Multi-tenant model serving architectures with cost isolation, quota management, and workload prioritization across competing internal consumers.Cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, or Azure at the architecture level, including cost modeling, capacity planning, and the tradeoffs between managed AI services and self-hosted infrastructure.Security and compliance architecture for AI systems handling proprietary manufacturing IP, including data residency, access controls, and audit trails.

    Platform engineering practices that make GenAI accessible and reliable for internal teams who are not AI practitioners: SDKs, abstraction layers, and self-service tooling.

SALARY RANGE

The compensation for this position is the range Slate reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; work location; and other relevant business and organizational factors.

Total Base Pay Range- $222,431.00 - $370,719.00

Additional Compensation and Benefits: Slate offers a wide range of competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, vacation, and 401k. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in the equity program and/or a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing such programs.

WHY JOIN TEAM SLATE?

At Slate, we’re fueled by grit, determination, and attention to detail. The start-up spirit of ingenuity and resourcefulness move our business forward. Team Slate fosters a culture of excellence, innovation, and mutual respect, and is motivated by shared principles.

  • Safety First

  • Delight Customers

  • One Team

  • Relentless Improvement

  • Fast, Frugal, and Scrappy

  • Respectful Collaboration

  • Positive Legacy

WE WANT TO WORK WITH PEOPLE THAT REFLECT THE COMMUNITIES IN WHICH WE OPERATE.

Slate is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason.

Slate is committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at

raw.description:
Lone Rock Point builds and manages digital experiences for public sector and mission-driven organizations, including migrating NASA's website and supporting its streaming service, work that has to serve millions of citizens in plain language and hold up under public scrutiny. We're looking for a Senior Content Strategist who can walk into a legacy site with years of accumulated content sprawl and leave it with a cohesive structure, voice, and governance model that the client's own team can run without us.

You'll work directly with government clients and our design and development team to take content from audit through migration and beyond. This role suits someone who's as comfortable running a content workshop with high-level stakeholders as they are building information architecture or writing a content model for a custom WordPress block, who can defend a plain-language recommendation to a program office that's used to bureaucratic copy, and who treats documentation and training handoff as part of finishing the job, not an afterthought.

What You'll Do

  • Lead content strategy engagements from discovery through launch, including content audits, gap analysis, and stakeholder interviews across multiple agency divisions
  • Design information architecture and taxonomy for large WordPress installations
  • Build content models for custom WordPress blocks and templates in partnership with designers and developers
  • Write and enforce editorial guidelines that meet the Plain Writing Act, Section 508, and WCAG 2.1 AA content requirements
  • Plan and execute content migrations, including inventorying legacy content and making the call on what gets rewritten, consolidated, or retired
  • Facilitate workshops and training sessions that hand off editorial ownership to client content teams
  • Use analytics and user research to justify structural and editorial recommendations, not just style preferences
  • Partner with content editors across the client's organization to consolidate and organize duplicate or overlapping content and review against established governance standards
  • Execute hands-on content creation and editing, including the production of original plain-language copy and the overhaul of legacy pages
  • Mentor other content strategists and content-adjacent team members

Requirements

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in content strategy, content design, or a closely related discipline, with a track record of owning strategy rather than executing someone else's
  • Experience running full content audits and building information architecture for complex, multi-stakeholder websites
  • Working knowledge of WordPress content structures, including custom post types, taxonomies, and block-based editing
  • Experience writing and defending content in plain language for a general public audience
  • Familiarity with Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility requirements as they apply to content, not just markup
  • Experience facilitating workshops or training with non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong written communication skills, including the ability to translate research and audit findings into recommendations a client will actually act on
  • Ability to work remotely and be self-directed
  • Proven ability to manage multiple client engagements at once

Ideal Content & Editorial Experience

  • Experience working in an agency, consultancy, or as a contractor
  • Content modeling and taxonomy design
  • Information architecture and site mapping
  • Editorial governance frameworks and style guides
  • Content migration planning and legacy content audits
  • Analytics tools such as Google Analytics or Parse.ly

Bonus Points if You Have

  • Prior experience with government, public-sector, or highly regulated clients
  • Familiarity with digital.gov guidance and the Plain Writing Act of 2010
  • Experience with UX writing or content design in a product team setting
  • Background in SEO strategy for large institutional websites
  • Experience training non-technical staff on WordPress editorial workflows
  • Prior experience acting as a mentor or leader on content team
  • U.S. Web Design System (USWDS) content patterns or similar atomic design system approaches

All roles at Lone Rock Point require the following

  • Legal authorization to work in the United States
  • Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired
  • Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future
  • May be subject to a non-government and/or government background check or security clearance
  • Work must be performed in the United States

Benefits

Competitive Compensation

We tie compensation to seniority and experience. We are currently searching for a mid-level Content Strategist with a salary band starting at $70/hr. If you consider yourself to be at a higher level, we still encourage you to apply and can discuss additional opportunities with you!

Lone Rock Point is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

Recruiting Agencies

Please do not contact. All of our positions are handled by our staff.

About the Organization

Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.
Redhorse transforms the way government utilizes data and technology. We are seeking a Junior Solutions Architect to support the technical design, development, and delivery of IT and cloud solutions. In this role, you will collaborate with lead architects, system engineers, and cross-functional teams to translate mission and user requirements into secure, scalable, and resilient technical architectures. This position supports federal and Department of Defense (DoD) engagements, offering an opportunity to contribute directly to modernizing critical public-sector systems using cloud-native and DevSecOps principles.

Key Responsibilities

    • Technical Design & Architecture: Assist in the design and modeling of end-to-end architectures, system integration diagrams, and technical specifications for federal IT programs.
    • Requirements Analysis: Collaborate with technical leads and stakeholders to decompose functional, operational, and mission requirements into structured solution designs and technical user stories.
    • Artifact Development: Produce and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including system-of-systems diagrams, interface control documents, and architectural blueprints for government review.
    • System Integration: Support the integration of multi-tier software applications, cloud hosting infrastructure, data engineering pipelines, and emerging artificial intelligence/machine learning (AI/ML) workflows.
    • Engineering Collaboration: Partner with software development, infrastructure, and test teams to provide architectural guidance, troubleshoot technical challenges, and ensure compliance with design standards.
    • Security & Compliance Alignment: Incorporate federal security baselines into architectural designs, supporting compliance with NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF), FedRAMP, and DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (IL2–IL6).
    • Process Enablement: Apply cloud-native design patterns, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and Agile development methodologies to support continuous delivery.

Required Skills

    • Security Clearance & Eligibility: Active DoD Secret security clearance and U.S. Citizenship (mandated by federal contract requirements).
    • Professional Experience: 4+ years of professional technical experience in software engineering, systems engineering, cloud engineering, or solutions architecture.
    • Cloud Platforms: Demonstrated experience designing, configuring, or deploying solutions within cloud computing environments (AWS preferred).
    • Application Architecture: Working knowledge of microservices architectures, full-stack design patterns, and API integration standards (REST, GraphQL).
    • Infrastructure Automation & Containers: Practical experience using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, AWS CloudFormation) and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
    • DevSecOps & CI/CD: Hands-on experience with automated CI/CD pipelines, version control workflows, and integrated security scanning practices.
    • Communication & Documentation: Demonstrated ability to create clear technical documentation and communicate complex technical concepts effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Desired Skills

    • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (or equivalent industry certification from Azure or GCP).
    • Prior experience delivering technical solutions within federal government or DoD contract environments.
    • Experience utilizing collaboration and data platforms such as GitLab, Jira, and Databricks.
    • Exposure to modern data architectures (e.g., data lakes, distributed data processing, ETL/ELT pipelines, Apache Spark).
    • Familiarity with AI/ML integration concepts (e.g., retrieval-augmented generation [RAG], LLM APIs, MLOps workflows).
    • Experience operating within Agile frameworks (e.g., Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).
The salary range provided for this position represents the anticipated base salary for successful candidates. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, education, certifications, skills, security clearance level, geographic location, market conditions, and internal equity. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may participate in Redhorse's comprehensive benefits programs and may be eligible for performance-based or other incentive compensation, where applicable.

Job Description: Director of Capacity Building and Coaching

JOB TITLEPROGRAMREPORTS TO SALARY

Director of Capacity Building and Coaching En ConjuntoExecutive Director of Community Development $75,000 to $90,000/Annual

LOCATIONJOB TYPEWORK SCHEDULE

Remote Full- Time Full - Time

General Description

The Director of Capacity Building and Coaching will build and lead a department within Urban Strategies to provide capacity-building and coaching services. The En Conjunto program strengthens Latino congregations by enhancing organizational capacity and engaging donors to support vibrant, thriving faith communities. The program offers faith-based organizations and leaders a range of services, including administrative support, organizational development consultation, holistic community development coaching, and access to funding opportunities in coordination with partner institutions.

This role will develop a strong coaching team to support congregations and other faith-based organizations, as well as contribute to Urban Strategies’ broader programs. The Director will play a key role in planning, coordinating operations, and evaluating program impact.

About You

The ideal candidate is a strategic and experienced leader in organizational coaching and

capacity-building for faith-based organizations. They bring expertise in coaching,

organizational development, administration services, strategic planning and implementation;

deep understanding of Hispanic communities, holistic community development, and Christian

traditions; strong team leadership, relationship-building, and operational management skills.

The candidate excels at designing and implementing systems that connect and equip

stakeholders, fostering collaboration among churches, community partners, and

organizations. With experience in program design, leadership, or community engagement—

ideally in faith-based or nonprofit settings— the candidate brings both vision and structure to

initiatives that create lasting impact.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in organizational leadership or development, business, nonprofit management, or a related field

  • Minimum of 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in nonprofit, faith-based, or community development organizations, and 5+ years of organizational coaching, and capacity building.

  • Proven experience managing programs, and teams.

  • Strong understanding of Hispanic culture, Christian traditions, and holistic community development.

  • Excellent strategic planning, communication, system orientation, and partnership-building skills.

  • Experience analyzing data and using the theory of change and logic model framework

  • Bilingual (Fluent English/Spanish) ·

  • Mission-driven, collaborative, and adaptable to changing needs.

What You’ll Be Doing

Leadership and Team Management

  • Build and lead a coaching and capacity-building department within Urban Strategies.

  • Develop and manage a team of coaches to support Latino congregations and faith-based organizations.

  • Promote professional development opportunities for staff.

  • Foster a culture of learning, reflection, and sharing of best practices within the team.

  • Program Delivery and Coaching

  • Provide organizational development consultation and coaching services to program participants and other Urban Strategies programs.

  • Assess, design, implement, and evaluate frameworks, resources, and systems to provide:

  • Administrative support services such as finance, marketing, and IT

  • Organizational development consultation

  • Holistic community and organizational development coaching for faith-based leaders and organizations

Operations and Collaboration

  • Coordinate and oversee program operations, ensuring alignment with strategic goals and mission.

  • Collaborate with other Urban Strategies programs to provide integrated support to congregations and communities.

  • Provide direction to the communications and marketing department to strategically promote programs and services.

  • Develop and maintain relationships with partners and other stakeholders to support program growth and sustainability.

  • Represent the organization at conferences, coalitions, and public events.

Evaluation and Reporting

  • Collect and analyze data to monitor program outcomes and impact.

  • Prepare regular reports for stakeholders on program progress and achievements.

  • Use feedback to make continuous improvements to the program.

Grant Development

  • Ensure timely and accurate grant reporting to program foundations and other stakeholders.

  • Lead engagement with program proposal partners, providing guidance on proposal development and implementation.

  • Develop and implement strategies to ensure program sustainability.

Other Responsibilities

  • Perform other tasks as assigned related to the program and role within Urban Strategies

About Urban Strategies

Urban Strategies exists to equip, resource and connect faith- and community-based organizations so that all children and families can reach their full potential. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., our team serves in the U.S. mainland, Puerto Rico, and Central America

COMPANY CULTURE

  • Our work is driven by our three core values:
  • Authentic Relationships are foundational to our work and move beyond a transactional nature to truly know people. They serve as opportunities for mutual development and growth and are based on the belief that all people have inherent dignity and worth.

🚢 Discover OneOcean:
OneOcean is a unified brand born from the integration of OneOcean and Ocean Technologies Group.
Owned by Lloyd’s Register, an organisation with more than 260 years of trust, integrity and leadership at sea, OneOcean combines the agility and ambition of a fast-moving innovator with the strength and stability of one of the world’s most trusted maritime institutions.
At the heart of OneOcean is a portfolio unlike any other in maritime. A comprehensive, integrated portfolio built on years of expertise, trusted by thousands of maritime professionals around the world.
🎯 Our Mission: Our mission is clear. In the race to zero emissions, our research, advisory and technical expertise and industry-firsts are supporting a safe, sustainable maritime energy transition. Today we are a leading provider of classification and compliance services to the marine and offshore industries, helping our clients design, construct and operate their assets to accepted levels of safety and environmental compliance.

🔍 Why Join OneOcean Crew?
Legacy & Innovation: We were created more than 260 years ago as the world’s first marine classification society to improve and set standards for the safety of ships.
Global Impact: Our digital solutions are relied upon by more than 30,000 vessels, following the acquisition of OneOcean in 2022 and Ocean Technologies Group in 2024.
Product Offering: Covering five proven product areas - learning, fleet operations, compliance, voyage planning and performance management - supporting its customers from ship to shore, from training and people operations, to voyage compliance and optimisation.
🧭 Navigating the position: Product Manager
We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Owner with a maritime industry background and extensive knowledge of the TM Master product. This role is critical to ensuring that the TM Master product evolves in line with the complex operational needs of modern shipping companies.
You will take responsibility for key TM Master Modules and act as the bridge between stakeholders, customers, and engineering teams—owning the product backlog for those modules.

Working with the Senior Product Manager, you will collaborate in shaping product strategy, defining priorities, and delivering high-impact features that improve operational efficiency, compliance, safety and vessel performance.
We are looking for someone who is genuinely curious about the problems maritime operators face, rigorous about how they make decisions, and comfortable working with ambiguity

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Delivery
  • Own and manage the TM Master product backlog, ensuring clear prioritisation aligned with business goals
  • Translate product strategy into actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Work closely with engineering teams in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver high-quality releases
  • Drive sprint planning, backlog grooming, and review sessions

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Collaborate with maritime customers (ship managers, superintendents, crew) to gather insights and validate requirements
  • Act as the voice of the customer, ensuring solutions address real operational challenges onboard and ashore
  • Align with internal stakeholders including Sales, Support, and Implementation teams

Product Strategy & Roadmap
  • Contribute to and execute the product roadmap for TM Master
  • Identify opportunities for innovation in maintenance, compliance, procurement, and vessel performance
  • Balance short-term delivery with long-term product vision

Domain Expertise & Compliance
  • Leverage knowledge of maritime operations (planned maintenance systems, safety, compliance)
  • Ensure product alignment with industry regulations (e.g., ISM, class requirements, audits)
  • Stay informed on trends in digital shipping, IoT, and fleet optimisation

Data & Continuous Improvement
  • Define and track product KPIs (adoption, performance, customer satisfaction)
  • Use data and user feedback to iterate and improve features
  • Champion continuous improvement and product excellence

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise


Product Ownership & Delivery
  • 5+ years experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager in a B2B environment
  • Strong track record of working in Agile/Scrum teams and delivering complex software products at scale
  • Proven ability to manage and prioritise large, complex backlogs
Maritime Domain Expertise
  • Solid experience within the maritime industry
  • Extensive knowledge of Planned Maintenance Systems (PMS) and associated operational workflows, in particular TM Master.
  • Strong understanding of vessel operations, compliance, and maintenance practices
TM Master / Product Knowledge
  • Extensive hands-on knowledge of the TMv2 product and its modules, data structures, and workflows
  • Ability to translate real-world maritime use cases into product requirements and improvements
Technical & Analytical Skills
  • Competent in using SQL Manager and writing queries for data analysis and validation
  • Comfortable working with data to support product decisions and troubleshoot issues
Stakeholder Communication
  • Strong ability to present user workflows, concepts, and solutions clearly to stakeholders and customers
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical audiences

Preferred Experience (Highly Desirable)
  • Experience in the maritime industry, particularly with: TM Master Planned Maintenance Systems (PMS), Fleet management software, Shipboard/offshore operations

Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange™️ platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 160+ public exchanges globally and thousands of private exchanges at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our team. This is a Remote role, reporting to the Sr. Director WW Field PM for AMS in the Data Security Product Organization department. As a key member of the Data Security Product Organization, your main focus of this position is to grow and sustain Zscaler core businesses revenues across the AMS region, with a special focus on AI-Powered Data Security product lines. You will work closely with Product Management and Sales leadership to manage field engagements and provide technical & commercial assistance to Sales Engineers and Account Executives throughout the customer lifecycle. Finally, you'll play a critical role in shaping the evolution of our platform by bringing real-world customer feedback from the field to help address emerging AI and data security challenges.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Drive the sales strategy and execution for the Data Security product suite specifically for our AMS customer base
  • Assist with Data Security opportunities to demonstrate technical superiority and business value
  • Partner with Product Management leadership to translate field insights into product strategy & roadmap by leading competitive analysis, win/loss reviews, customer commitment tracking, pricing planning, and pipeline and churn analysis across the DLP, DSPM, and AI portfolio.
  • Enable and educate the broader Zscaler field team to effectively position and sell Data Security solutions within their accounts
  • Work with support leadership to provide timely assistance to large customers in event of escalations and deployment of Zscaler services
  • Provide clear, concise, and data-driven updates on deal status, pipeline health, business performance, and key risks to Sales and Product leadership, enabling informed decision-making.

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging AI solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain.
  • Proven professional experience in a technical, customer-facing role such as a Sales Engineer, Solution Architect, or Product Manager.
  • Deep expertise in Data Security technologies like Cloud DLP, Inline DLP, CASB, Email/Endpoint DLP, DSPM, AISPM, SSPM & securing AI agents.
  • Deep understanding of SWG, ZTNA, proxies, firewalls, VPN, Secure Browser, and authentication/identity protocols such as SAML and SCIM
  • Subject matter expertise in infrastructure deployment within a major public cloud environment (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced setting using modern project management tools to track engagement and activity.

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Deep technical understanding of Generative AI infrastructure and cloud security platforms, with proven experience designing, scaling, or securing AI-driven data detection, automated policy generation, and addressing architectural data security risks.
  • Comprehensive understanding of core Internet and network protocols (including TCP, UDP, HTTP/S, DNS, SSL/TLS) and modern network traffic architectures.
  • Exceptional communication skills combined with strategic insight into how enterprise customers leverage digital transformation, automation, and evolving data integration patterns to drive measurable business outcomes.

Job Summary: The Sr. Analyst FP&A - Revenue supports revenue forecasting, realization, WIP, AR, margin and revenue driver analysis. This role develops recurring revenue reporting, supports budget and forecast assumptions, identifies performance trends and partners with accounting and business partnership teams on revenue close handoffs and practice-facing insights.

Responsibilities

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Prepares recurring revenue, billable hours, utilization, realization, margin, WIP, AR, write-off and backlog reporting for monthly close, forecast updates and leadership review.
  • Analyzes revenue performance by practice, segment, partner, service line and client, identifying drivers of volume, rates, mix, utilization, billing velocity, WIP aging and collection trends.
  • Manages add-back expense entries, validation and reporting.
  • Supports revenue forecast models using operational drivers such as billable hours, staffing capacity, realization, backlog, pipeline, rate changes, seasonality and known client activity.
  • Supports M&A integration into budget processes and reporting, including acquired revenue mapping, budget baseline setup, reporting alignment, practice/segment coding and forecast integration.
  • Partners with accounting and billing teams on revenue close support, WIP reserve analysis, unbilled WIP review, AR aging trends and revenue-related reporting controls.
  • Supports the accounting team on cost center and account structures that align with business needs.
  • Develops dashboards and analysis that help leaders understand revenue leakage, scope creep, write-downs, staffing mix, pricing impacts and cash conversion risks.
  • Prepares clear commentary and recommendations for FP&A, Finance Business Partnership and leaders to support revenue planning and performance improvement actions.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Economics or related field.
  • Four+ years of FP&A, revenue analytics, financial analysis, professional services finance or related analytical experience.
  • Experience with revenue forecasting, operational metrics, variance analysis, financial modeling and management reporting.
  • Experience using automation, dashboarding, data tools or AI-enabled analysis to improve revenue reporting, forecast support and recurring analytical processes.

Skills & Abilities:

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to connect revenue, utilization, realization, WIP, AR and staffing metrics to financial performance.
  • Ability to build models, validate data, explain trends and prepare concise recommendations for finance and business leaders.
  • Ability to use automation and AI-enabled tools to streamline revenue dashboards, variance explanations, WIP/AR analysis and forecast support.
  • Strong Excel, reporting, dashboarding and systems skills, with comfort improving recurring analytical processes.

raw.description:
Category: IT Services

Location: Fort Colombo Sri Lanka


For an international organization in New York, we are urgently looking for a REMOTE Salesforce Support Analyst. Candidates need to be fluent in English. All positions are long-term. This position is open for contractors and employees.
Candidates need to be able to work 4-6 hours per day in the normal office hours of New York, US. Example 9 AM NY time equals 7:30 PM.
Tasks and responsibilities:
  • Work with an agile team to manage support activities for Salesforce, Conga Composer, and Form Assembly implementations;
  • Provide end-user support
  • Perform system configurations such as working with custom objects, triggers, and workflows.
  • Create and maintain Conga Reports;
  • Create and maintain Form Assembly forms/campaigns;
  • Create and maintain complete documentation for configuration specifications;
  • Assist with system maintenance;
  • Assist in the gathering of requirements, propose solutions and workarounds based on platform features and limitations;
  • Communicate technical solutions/concepts with trade-offs, risks, and benefits;
  • Support data activities including extracting, normalizing, mapping, and uploading data as required. Ensure data integrity through the appropriate use of de-duping and data loading tools;
  • Develop and conduct training sessions and update training materials;
  • Keep abreast with new Salesforce features and functionality and provide recommendations for process improvements;
Profile:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology/related field or equivalent professional experience is required;
  • Demonstrated Salesforce production support experience with attention to detail and track record of delivering against objectives;
  • +5 years of experience configuring and deploying Salesforce solutions;
  • 3 years of experience in building forms and reports with Form Assembly and Conga Composer;
  • Knowledge of security and access control in Salesforce Lightning Enterprise Edition, project deployments, and environment management;
  • Fluent in English;
